title.zh: 卷三 本紀第三 武帝下
title.raw: 卷三 本紀第三 武帝下 Volume 3: Emperor Wu 3

sentences.zh: 梁書卷第三 本紀第三

translations.literal: Book of Liang, Volume 3, Basic Annals 3
translations.idiomatic: Book of Liang, Volume 3, Annals 3

sentences.zh: 武帝下

translations.literal: Emperor Wu, Part 3
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu, Lower Annals

sentences.zh: 普通元年春正月乙亥朔，改元，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring, first day yihai, year 1 of Putong, the reign title was changed and a general amnesty was proclaimed for the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the first day of spring in Putong 1 (520 CE), the era name was changed and a general amnesty was declared.

sentences.zh: 賜文武勞位，孝悌力田爵一級，尤貧之家，勿收常調，鰥寡孤獨，並加贍卹。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were granted rank for their labors; those showing filial piety and diligence in farming received one rank of nobility; especially poor households were exempted from regular levies; widowers, widows, orphans, and solitaries all received additional relief.
translations.idiomatic: Meritorious civil and military officials were rewarded with rank; filial and diligent farmers gained one noble rank; the poorest households were exempt from regular taxes; widowers, widows, orphans, and the alone received extra relief.

sentences.zh: 丙子，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On bingzi, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以司徒臨川王宏爲太尉、揚州刺史，安右將軍、監揚州蕭景爲安西將軍、郢州刺史。

translations.literal: On jimao, Prince of Linchuan Hong, Minister over the Masses, was made Grand Commandant and Yangzhou Inspector; General Who Pacifies the Right and Supervisor of Yangzhou Xiao Jing was made General Who Pacifies the West and Yingzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Minister over the Masses and Prince of Linchuan Hong became Grand Commandant and Yangzhou inspector; General Who Pacifies the Right Xiao Jing, supervisor of Yangzhou, became General Who Pacifies the West and Yingzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 尚書左僕射王暕以母憂去職，金紫光祿大夫王份爲尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Wang Dan, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, left office on account of his mother's mourning; Jinzi-guanglu Grand Master Wang Fen was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Director Wang Dan resigned for mourning; Jinzi-guanglu Grand Master Wang Fen replaced him as Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 庚子，扶南、高麗國各遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Funan and Goguryeo each sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Funan and Goguryeo each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，老人星見。

translations.literal: In the second month, on renzi, the Old Man Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renzi, the Old Man Star was seen.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以高麗王世子安爲寧東將軍、高麗王。

translations.literal: On guichou, Goguryeo crown prince An was made General Who Pacifies the East and King of Goguryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Goguryeo crown prince An was made General Who Pacifies the East and king of Goguryeo.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌，滑國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the third month, on bingxu, the state of Huaguo sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingxu, Huaguo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲午，河南王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on jiawu, the King of Henan sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiawu, the King of Henan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月丁未，以護軍將軍韋叡爲車騎將軍。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dingwei, Protector of the Army General Wei Rui was made General of Chariots and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingwei, Protector of the Army Wei Rui was promoted to General of Chariots and Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己卯，江、淮、海並溢。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jimao, the Yangtze, Huai, and sea all overflowed together.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jimao, the Yangtze, Huai, and the coast all flooded at once.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以信威將軍卲陵王綸爲江州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinmao, General of Trustworthy Might Prince of Shaoling Lun was made Jiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, General of Trustworthy Might and Prince of Shaoling Lun was made Jiangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，老人星見。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on gengxu, the Old Man Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengxu, the Old Man Star was seen.

sentences.zh: 甲子，新除車騎將軍韋叡卒。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the newly appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry Wei Rui died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the newly appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry Wei Rui died.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，有星晨見東方，光爛如火。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on yihai, a morning star appeared in the east, its light blazing like fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yihai, a morning star appeared in the east, blazing like fire.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛亥，以宣惠將軍長沙王深業爲護軍將軍。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on xinhai, General Who Proclaims Grace Prince of Changsha Shenye was made Protector of the Army General.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on xinhai, General Who Proclaims Grace and Prince of Changsha Shenye was made Protector of the Army.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以丹陽尹晉安王綱爲平西將軍、益州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Intendant of Danyang Prince of Jin'an Gang was made General Who Pacifies the West and Yizhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Danyang intendant and Prince of Jin'an Gang was made General Who Pacifies the West and Yizhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月甲戌，以南徐州刺史豫章王綜爲鎮右將軍。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring, year 2, on jiaxu, South Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Yuzhang Zong was made General Who Guards the Right.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 2, on jiaxu, South Xuzhou inspector and Prince of Yuzhang Zong was made General Who Guards the Right.

sentences.zh: 新除益州刺史晉安王綱改爲徐州刺史。

translations.literal: The newly appointed Yizhou Inspector Prince of Jin'an Gang was changed to Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: The newly appointed Yizhou inspector, Prince of Jin'an Gang, was reassigned as Xuzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，輿駕親祠南郊。

translations.literal: On xinsi, the imperial carriage personally performed sacrifice at the Southern Suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the emperor personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburbs.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「春司御氣，虔恭報祀，陶匏剋誠，蒼璧禮備，思隨乾覆，布茲亭育。

translations.literal: An edict said: "The spring office governs the qi—reverently and respectfully making offering in return; earthen vessels and gourds express sincerity, the azure bi completes the rite; my thoughts follow Heaven's covering, spreading this nourishing care.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "The spring office governs the vital breath; with reverent offering I return thanks—earthen vessels and gourds show sincerity, the azure bi completes the rite; my thoughts follow Heaven's shelter, spreading this care for all.

sentences.zh: 凡民有單老孤稚，不能自存，主者郡縣咸加收養，贍給衣食，每令周足，以終其身。

translations.literal: All among the people who are solitary elderly or orphaned young and cannot support themselves—the responsible officials in commanderies and counties shall all take them in for rearing, provide clothing and food, ensuring full sufficiency each time until the end of their lives.
translations.idiomatic: Any solitary elder or orphaned child who cannot support himself shall be taken in by the local commandery or county, given food and clothing in full measure, and cared for to the end of life.

sentences.zh: 又於京師置孤獨園，孤幼有歸，華髮不匱。

translations.literal: Also at the capital a Garden for the Solitary and Alone was established—orphans and young have a home, white-haired elders do not lack.
translations.idiomatic: A Garden for the Solitary and Alone was also established at the capital, so orphans and young have a refuge and white-haired elders do not go wanting.

sentences.zh: 若終年命，厚加料理。

translations.literal: If they reach the end of their allotted span, generous arrangements shall be made.
translations.idiomatic: When they reach the end of their lives, generous arrangements are to be made.

sentences.zh: 尤窮之家，勿收租賦。

translations.literal: Especially poor households shall not be charged rent and levies.
translations.idiomatic: The poorest households are exempt from rent and levies.

sentences.zh: 」戊子，大赦天下。

translations.literal: "On wuzi, a general amnesty was proclaimed for the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, a general amnesty was proclaimed for the empire.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，輿駕親祠明堂。

translations.literal: In the second month, on xinchou, the imperial carriage personally performed sacrifice at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinchou, the emperor personally sacrificed at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，大雪，平地三尺。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengyin, heavy snow fell, three chi deep on level ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengyin, heavy snow piled three chi deep on level ground.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，改作南北郊。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on yimao, the Northern and Southern Suburban altars were rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yimao, the Northern and Southern Suburban altars were rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔曰：「夫欽若昊天，歷象無違。

translations.literal: On bingchen, an edict said: "Reverently conforming to August Heaven, the calendar and stars admit no deviation.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, an edict said, "Reverently conforming to August Heaven, the calendar and stars must not be violated.

sentences.zh: 躬執耒耜，盡力致敬，上協星鳥，俯訓民時，平秩東作，義不在南。

translations.literal: Personally holding plow and hoe, exerting full strength in reverent offering, above harmonizing with the stellar birds, below instructing the people in the seasons, ordering the eastern labors in their ranks—the rite does not belong in the south.
translations.idiomatic: Personally holding plow and hoe and offering full reverence, harmonizing above with the stars and instructing below the people in the seasons, ordering the eastern labors in their ranks—the rite does not belong in the south.

sentences.zh: 前代因襲，有乖禮制，可於震方，簡求沃野，具茲千畝，庶允舊章。」

translations.literal: Former ages followed precedent with deviation from ritual form; in the direction of Zhen one may select fertile wilds and prepare these thousand mu, that the old statutes may be fulfilled."
translations.idiomatic: Former ages followed precedent in ways that violated ritual; in the east one may select fertile land and prepare these thousand mu, so the old statutes may be fulfilled."

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，琬琰殿火，延燒後宮屋三千間。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on guimao, fire broke out in Wanyan Hall and spread to burn three thousand rooms of the rear palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guimao, Wanyan Hall caught fire and the blaze spread through three thousand rooms of the rear palace.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔曰：「王公卿士，今拜表賀瑞，雖則百辟體國之誠，朕懷良有多愧。

translations.literal: On dingsi, an edict said: "Princes, dukes, and ministers—now submitting memorials congratulating us on auspicious omens—though this is the hundred officials' sincere care for the state, in my heart there is much shame.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, an edict said, "Princes, dukes, and ministers now submit memorials congratulating us on auspicious omens; though this shows the hundred officials' care for the state, I feel much shame.

sentences.zh: 若其澤漏川泉，仁被動植，氣調玉燭，治致太平，爰降嘉祥，可無慚德；

translations.literal: If grace overflowed like springs and rivers, benevolence covered the moving and rooted, the qi harmonized like the jade measure, governance reached great peace, and auspicious blessings descended—then one might be without shame for virtue;
translations.idiomatic: If grace overflowed like springs, benevolence covered all living things, the seasons ran true, governance reached great peace, and blessings descended—then one might feel no shame;

sentences.zh: 而政道多缺，淳化未凝，何以仰叶辰和，遠臻冥貺？

translations.literal: but the way of governance has many gaps, pure transformation is not yet fixed—how then to look up and accord with the harmony of the stars, or reach far to the dark bestowal?
translations.idiomatic: but the way of governance has many gaps and pure custom is not yet fixed—how then can I accord with heavenly harmony or earn distant blessing?

sentences.zh: 此乃更彰寡薄，重增其尤。

translations.literal: This only makes my slightness more manifest and adds further to the fault.
translations.idiomatic: This only exposes my slightness and adds to the fault.

sentences.zh: 自今可停賀瑞。」

translations.literal: From now on congratulations on auspicious omens may cease."
translations.idiomatic: From now on, congratulations on auspicious omens are to cease."

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，信威將軍、義州刺史文僧明以州叛入于魏。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dingmao, General of Trustworthy Might and Yizhou Inspector Wen Sengming rebelled with his province and went over to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingmao, General of Trustworthy Might and Yizhou inspector Wen Sengming rebelled and defected to Wei.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁酉，假大匠卿裴邃節，督衆軍北討。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on dingyou, Acting Chief Master of Construction Pei Su was given the credential and directed the massed armies in a northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingyou, Acting Chief Master of Construction Pei Su was given command and directed the armies on a northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，老人星見。

translations.literal: On jiayin, the Old Man Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the Old Man Star was seen.

sentences.zh: 魏荊州刺史桓叔興帥衆降。

translations.literal: Wei's Jingzhou Inspector Huan Shuxing led his host in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Wei's Jingzhou inspector Huan Shuxing surrendered with his forces.

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥，始平郡中石鼓村地自開成井，方六尺六寸，深三十二丈。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on dinghai, in Shigu village of Shiping commandery the ground opened by itself into a well, six chi six cun square and thirty-two zhang deep.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dinghai, the ground in Shigu village, Shiping commandery, opened by itself into a well six chi six cun square and thirty-two zhang deep.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，百濟、新羅國各遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, Baekje and Silla each sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, Baekje and Silla each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊辰，以鎮東大將軍百濟王餘隆爲寧東大將軍。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuchen, Baekje King Yulong, General Who Guards the East, was made Grand General Who Pacifies the East.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuchen, Baekje king Yulong, General Who Guards the East, was promoted to Grand General Who Pacifies the East.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月庚子，以尚書令袁昂爲中書監，吳郡太守王暕爲尚書左僕射，尚書左僕射王份爲右光祿大夫。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring, year 3, on gengzi, Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Ang was made Supervisor of the Masters of Writing; Wu commandery Administrator Wang Dan was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Left Vice Director Wang Fen was made Right Grand Master of the Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 3, on gengzi, Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Ang became Supervisor of the Masters of Writing; Wu commandery administrator Wang Dan became Left Vice Director; Left Vice Director Wang Fen became Right Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，京師地震。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 己未，以宣毅將軍廬陵王續爲雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiwei, General Who Proclaims Resolution Prince of Luling Xu was made Yongzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, General Who Proclaims Resolution and Prince of Luling Xu was made Yongzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，巴陵王蕭屏薨。

translations.literal: In the third month, on yimao, Prince of Baling Xiao Ping died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yimao, Prince of Baling Xiao Ping died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁卯，汝陰王劉端薨。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on dingmao, Prince of Ruyin Liu Duan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingmao, Prince of Ruyin Liu Duan died.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰朔，日有蝕之，旣。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, first day renchen, there was a solar eclipse; it ended.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the first day of the fifth month, there was a solar eclipse; when it ended,

sentences.zh: 癸巳，赦天下。

translations.literal: On guisi, an amnesty was proclaimed for the empire.
translations.idiomatic: on guisi an amnesty was proclaimed for the empire.

sentences.zh: 並班下四方，民所疾苦，鹹卽以聞，公卿百僚各上封事，連率郡國舉賢良、方正、直言之士。

translations.literal: Orders were also sent out to the four directions: the people's hardships were all to be reported at once; dukes, ministers, and the hundred officials were each to submit sealed memorials; regional inspectors and commanderies were to recommend worthy, upright, and plain-speaking men.
translations.idiomatic: Orders went out to the four directions: popular hardships were to be reported at once; officials were to submit sealed memorials; regional inspectors and commanderies were to recommend worthy, upright, and plain-speaking men.

sentences.zh: 秋八月辛酉，作二郊及籍田並畢，班賜工匠各有差。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, on xinyou, construction of the two suburban altars and the sacred field was completed, and craftsmen were rewarded in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on xinyou, the two suburban altars and the sacred field were completed, and craftsmen were rewarded in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 甲子，老人星見。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the Old Man Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the Old Man Star was seen.

sentences.zh: 婆利、白題國各遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Bali and Baiti each sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: Bali and Baiti each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙子，加中書監袁昂中衛將軍。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on bingzi, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing Yuan Ang was additionally made Central Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on bingzi, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing Yuan Ang was additionally made Central Guard General.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午，撫軍將軍、開府儀同三司、領軍將軍始興王憺薨。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiawu, Pacification Army General, Bearer of the Staff with the Same Three Dignities as the Three Lords, and Army Inspector Prince of Shixing Dan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiawu, Pacification Army General, Bearer of the Staff with ministerial honors, and Army Inspector Prince of Shixing Dan died.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以太子詹事蕭淵藻爲領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Crown Prince's Household Director Xiao Yuanzao was made Army Inspector General.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Crown Prince's Household Director Xiao Yuanzao was made Army Inspector.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月辛卯，輿駕親祠南郊，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring, year 4, on xinmao, the imperial carriage personally performed sacrifice at the Southern Suburbs and a general amnesty was proclaimed for the empire.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 4, on xinmao, the emperor personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburbs and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 應諸窮疾，咸加賑卹，並班下四方，時理獄訟。

translations.literal: All who suffered extreme poverty or illness received relief; orders were sent out to the four directions, and lawsuits were promptly adjudicated.
translations.idiomatic: All who suffered extreme poverty or illness received relief; orders went out to the four directions and lawsuits were promptly heard.

sentences.zh: 丙午，輿駕親祠明堂。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the imperial carriage personally performed sacrifice at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the emperor personally sacrificed at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午，老人星見。

translations.literal: In the second month, on gengwu, the Old Man Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengwu, the Old Man Star was seen.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，躬耕籍田。

translations.literal: On yihai, he personally plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the emperor personally plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「夫耕籍之義大矣哉！

translations.literal: An edict said: "The meaning of plowing the sacred field is great indeed!
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "The meaning of plowing the sacred field is great indeed!

sentences.zh: 粢盛由之而興，禮節因之以著，古者哲王咸用此作。

translations.literal: Sacred grain rises from it, ritual form is thereby made manifest—ancient sage kings all used this practice.
translations.idiomatic: Sacred grain rises from it and ritual form is made manifest; ancient sage kings all used this practice.

sentences.zh: 眷言八政，致茲千畝，公卿百辟，恪恭其儀，九推畢禮，馨香靡替。

translations.literal: Reflecting on the eight policies, reaching these thousand mu, dukes, ministers, and the hundred officials reverently performed the rites; the ninefold push completed the ceremony, fragrant offering unceasing.
translations.idiomatic: Reflecting on the eight policies at these thousand mu, dukes, ministers, and the hundred officials reverently performed the rites; the ninefold push completed the ceremony and the fragrant offering did not cease.

sentences.zh: 兼以風雲叶律，氣象光華，屬覽休辰，思加獎勸。

translations.literal: Moreover wind and cloud accorded with the pitch pipes, the qi-signs were bright and splendid; on reviewing this auspicious day, I think to add reward and encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover wind and cloud accorded with the pitch pipes and the signs were bright; on this auspicious day I wish to add reward and encouragement.

sentences.zh: 可班下遠近，廣辟良疇，公私畎畝，務盡地利。

translations.literal: Orders may be sent out far and near to open wide good fields; public and private plots alike shall exhaust the land's advantage.
translations.idiomatic: Orders are to go out far and near to open good fields; public and private plots alike must make full use of the land.

sentences.zh: 若欲附農而糧種有乏，亦加貸卹，每使優遍。

translations.literal: If one wishes to attach to farming but lacks seed grain, additional loans and relief shall also be granted, always making the benefit broad and complete.
translations.idiomatic: If one wishes to farm but lacks seed grain, loans and relief are also to be granted, always making the benefit broad and complete.

sentences.zh: 孝悌力田賜爵一級。

translations.literal: Those showing filial piety and diligence in farming are granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: Those showing filial piety and diligence in farming receive one rank of nobility.

sentences.zh: 預耕之司，剋日勞酒。」

translations.literal: The offices participating in the plowing shall, on the appointed day, offer labor wine."
translations.idiomatic: The offices participating in the plowing shall, on the appointed day, offer labor wine."

sentences.zh: 三月壬寅，以鎮右將軍豫章王綜爲平北將軍、南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: In the third month, on renyin, General Who Guards the Right Prince of Yuzhang Zong was made General Who Pacifies the North and South Yanzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renyin, General Who Guards the Right and Prince of Yuzhang Zong was made General Who Pacifies the North and South Yanzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 六月乙丑，分益州置信州，分交州置愛州，分廣州置成州、南定州、合州、建州，分霍州置義州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on yichou, Yizhou was divided to establish Xin province; Jiaozhou was divided to establish Ai province; Guangzhou was divided to establish Cheng, South Ding, He, and Jian provinces; Huo province was divided to establish Yi province.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yichou, Yizhou was split to create Xin province; Jiaozhou to create Ai province; Guangzhou to create Cheng, South Ding, He, and Jian provinces; and Huo province to create Yi province.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丁卯，老人星見。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, on dingmao, the Old Man Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on dingmao, the Old Man Star was seen.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚午，以中書監、中衛將軍袁昂爲尚書令，卽本號開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on gengwu, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and Central Guard General Yuan Ang was made Director of the Masters of Writing, retaining his original title as Bearer of the Staff with the Same Three Dignities as the Three Lords.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on gengwu, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing and Central Guard General Yuan Ang became Director of the Masters of Writing while retaining his ministerial honors.

sentences.zh: 己卯，護軍將軍昌義之卒。

translations.literal: On jimao, Protector of the Army General Chang Yizhi died.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Protector of the Army Chang Yizhi died.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸未朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, first day guiwei, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the first day of the eleventh month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 太白晝見。

translations.literal: The Metal Star appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，尚書左僕射王暕卒。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Dan died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Left Vice Director Wang Dan died.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午，始鑄鐵錢。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuwu, iron coin was first cast.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuwu, iron coin was first cast.

sentences.zh: 狼牙脩國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Langyaxiu sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: Langyaxiu sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月，以左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司南平王偉爲鎮衛大將軍，改領右光祿大夫，儀同三司如故。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring, year 5, Left Grand Master of the Palace and Bearer of the Staff with the Same Three Dignities as the Three Lords Prince of Nanping Wei was made Grand General Who Guards the Realm; he was changed to hold Right Grand Master of the Palace, his Bearer of the Staff status unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 5, Left Grand Master of the Palace and Bearer of the Staff Prince of Nanping Wei was made Grand General Who Guards the Realm and reassigned as Right Grand Master of the Palace with ministerial honors unchanged.

sentences.zh: 征西將軍、開府儀同三司、荊州刺史鄱陽王恢進號驃騎大將軍。

translations.literal: General Who Conquers the West, Bearer of the Staff with the Same Three Dignities as the Three Lords, and Jingzhou Inspector Prince of Poyang Hui was promoted to General of Agile Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Conquers the West, Bearer of the Staff, and Jingzhou inspector Prince of Poyang Hui was promoted to General of Agile Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 太府卿夏侯亶爲中護軍。

translations.literal: Minister of the Imperial Treasury Xiahou Dan was made Central Army Protector.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of the Imperial Treasury Xiahou Dan was made Central Army Protector.

sentences.zh: 右光祿大夫王份爲左光祿大夫，加特進。

translations.literal: Right Grand Master of the Palace Wang Fen was made Left Grand Master of the Palace and additionally granted Special Advancement.
translations.idiomatic: Right Grand Master of the Palace Wang Fen became Left Grand Master of the Palace and was additionally granted Special Advancement.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，平北將軍、南兗州刺史豫章王綜進號鎮北將軍。

translations.literal: On xinmao, General Who Pacifies the North and South Yanzhou Inspector Prince of Yuzhang Zong was promoted to General Who Guards the North.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, General Who Pacifies the North and South Yanzhou inspector Prince of Yuzhang Zong was promoted to General Who Guards the North.

sentences.zh: 平西將軍、雍州刺史晉安王綱進號安北將軍。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the West and Yongzhou Inspector Prince of Jin'an Gang was promoted to General Who Pacifies the North.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Pacifies the West and Yongzhou inspector Prince of Jin'an Gang was promoted to General Who Pacifies the North.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午，特進、左光祿大夫王份卒。

translations.literal: In the second month, on gengwu, Special Advancement and Left Grand Master of the Palace Wang Fen died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengwu, Special Advancement and Left Grand Master of the Palace Wang Fen died.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，老人星見。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the Old Man Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the Old Man Star was seen.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌，分揚州、江州置東揚州。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiaxu, Yangzhou and Jiangzhou were divided to establish East Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiaxu, Yangzhou and Jiangzhou were split to create East Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未，以雲麾將軍南康王績爲江州刺史。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on yiwei, General of Cloud Pennons Prince of Nankang Ji was made Jiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yiwei, General of Cloud Pennons and Prince of Nankang Ji was made Jiangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，龍鬬于曲阿王陂，因西行至建陵城。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on yiyou, dragons fought at Qu'e Wang's embankment and then traveled west to Jianling city.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yiyou, dragons fought at Qu'e Wang's embankment and then moved west to Jianling city.

sentences.zh: 所經處樹木倒折，開地數十丈。

translations.literal: Where they passed, trees were snapped and uprooted, opening ground several tens of zhang.
translations.idiomatic: Along their path trees were snapped and uprooted, tearing open ground several tens of zhang wide.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以會稽太守武陵王紀爲東揚州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Kuaiji Administrator Prince of Wuling Ji was made East Yangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Kuaiji administrator and Prince of Wuling Ji was made East Yangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以員外散騎常侍元樹爲平北將軍、北青、兗二州刺史，率衆北伐。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Supernumerary Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary Yuan Shu was made General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of North Qing and Yan provinces, leading the host on a northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Supernumerary Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary Yuan Shu was made General Who Pacifies the North and inspector of North Qing and Yan provinces, leading forces on a northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，賜北討義客位一階。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on xinwei, volunteers in the northern campaign were granted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinwei, volunteers in the northern campaign were granted one rank.

sentences.zh: 八月庚寅，徐州刺史成景雋剋魏童城。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day gengyin, Xuzhou Inspector Cheng Jingjuan captured Wei's Tong city.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day in the eighth month, Xuzhou inspector Cheng Jingjuan took Wei's Tong city.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，又剋睢陵城。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day wushen, he again captured Suiling city.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day in the ninth month, he captured Suiling city as well.

sentences.zh: 戊午，北兗州刺史趙景悅圍荊山。

translations.literal: On wuwu, North Yanzhou Inspector Zhao Jingyue besieged Jingshan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, North Yanzhou inspector Zhao Jingyue laid siege to Jingshan.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，宣毅將軍裴邃襲壽陽，入羅城，弗剋。

translations.literal: On renxu, General Who Displays Boldness Pei Sui raided Shouyang, entered the outer wall, but did not capture it.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, General Who Displays Boldness Pei Sui struck Shouyang, broke into the outer wall, and failed to take the city.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅，裴邃、元樹攻魏建陵城，破之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, day wuyin, Pei Sui and Yuan Shu attacked Wei's Jianling city and broke it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day in the tenth month of winter, Pei Sui and Yuan Shu stormed Wei's Jianling city and broke it.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，又破曲木。

translations.literal: On xinsi, they again broke Qumu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day they broke Qumu as well.

sentences.zh: 掃虜將軍彭寶孫剋琅邪。

translations.literal: General Who Sweeps Barbarians Peng Baosun captured Langye.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Sweeps Barbarians Peng Baosun took Langye.

sentences.zh: 甲申，又剋檀丘城。

translations.literal: On jiashen, he again captured Tanqiu city.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day he captured Tanqiu city as well.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，裴邃破狄城。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Pei Sui broke Dicheng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Pei Sui broke Dicheng.

sentences.zh: 丙申，又剋甓城，遂進屯黎漿。

translations.literal: On bingshen, he again captured Picheng, then advanced and encamped at Lijiang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day he took Picheng as well, then pushed forward and encamped at Lijiang.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，魏東海太守韋敬欣以司吾城降。

translations.literal: On renyin, Wei's Donghai Administrator Wei Jingxin surrendered Siwu city.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Wei's Donghai administrator Wei Jingxin surrendered Siwu city.

sentences.zh: 定遠將軍太守□□曹世宗破魏曲陽城。

translations.literal: General Who Establishes the Distance and Administrator Cao Shizong broke Wei's Quyang city.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Establishes the Distance Cao Shizong broke Wei's Quyang city.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，又剋秦墟。

translations.literal: On jiachen, he again captured Qinxu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day he captured Qinxu as well.

sentences.zh: 魏郿、潘溪守悉皆棄城走。

translations.literal: The defenders of Wei's Mei and Panxi all abandoned their cities and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The garrisons at Wei's Mei and Panxi all abandoned their cities and fled.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，彭寶孫剋東莞城。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, day bingchen, Peng Baosun captured Dongguan city.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day in the eleventh month, Peng Baosun took Dongguan city.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，裴邃攻壽陽之安城，剋之。

translations.literal: On renxu, Pei Sui attacked An city of Shouyang and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Pei Sui assaulted An city at Shouyang and took it.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，魏馬頭、安城並來降。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Wei's Matou and Ancheng both came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Wei's Matou and Ancheng both surrendered.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅，魏荊山城降。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, day wuyin, Wei's Jingshan city surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day in the twelfth month, Wei's Jingshan city surrendered.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，武勇將軍李國興攻平靜關，剋之。

translations.literal: On yisi, General of Martial Valor Li Guoxing attacked Pingjing Pass and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day General of Martial Valor Li Guoxing attacked Pingjing Pass and took it.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，信威長史楊法乾攻武陽關；

translations.literal: On xinchou, Xinwei Chief Clerk Yang Faqian attacked Wuyang Pass;
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Xinwei chief clerk Yang Faqian attacked Wuyang Pass;

sentences.zh: 壬寅，攻峴關：並剋之。

translations.literal: On renyin, he attacked Xian Pass: both were captured.
translations.idiomatic: on renyin day he attacked Xian Pass as well, and both passes fell.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月丙午，安北將軍晉安王綱遣長史柳津破魏南鄉郡，司馬董當門破魏晉城。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the sixth year, day bingwu, General Who Pacifies the North Prince Gang of Jin'an sent Chief Clerk Liu Jin to break Wei's South Xiang commandery, and Major Dong Dangmen to break Wei's Jincheng.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day in the first month of spring, year 6, General Who Pacifies the North Prince Gang of Jin'an sent chief clerk Liu Jin to break Wei's South Xiang commandery and major Dong Dangmen to break Wei's Jincheng.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，又破馬圈、彫陽二城。

translations.literal: On gengxu, he again broke Maquan and Diaoyang, two cities.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day he broke Maquan and Diaoyang as well.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，輿駕親祠南郊，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburbs, and a general amnesty was granted for the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the emperor sacrificed at the Southern Suburbs in person and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 庚申，魏鎮東將軍、徐州刺史元法僧以彭城內附。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Wei's General Who Guards the East and Xuzhou Inspector Yuan Faseng brought Pengcheng over to the court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Wei's General Who Guards the East and Xuzhou inspector Yuan Faseng surrendered Pengcheng to the court.

sentences.zh: 己巳，雍州前軍剋魏新蔡郡。

translations.literal: On jisi, Yongzhou's vanguard broke Wei's Xincai commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Yongzhou's vanguard broke Wei's Xincai commandery.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「廟謨已定，王略方舉。

translations.literal: An edict said: "The plan in the temple is settled, and the royal strategy is now to be raised.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "The plan in the temple is fixed and the royal strategy is about to unfold.

sentences.zh: 侍中、領軍將軍西昌侯淵藻，可便親戎，以前啓行；

translations.literal: Palace Attendant and General Who Leads the Army Marquis Yuanzao of Xichang may at once take command in person, advancing as before;
translations.idiomatic: Palace attendant and General Who Leads the Army Marquis Yuanzao of Xichang is to take the field in person at once and advance as before;

sentences.zh: 鎮北將軍、南兗州刺史豫章王綜董馭雄桀，風馳次邁；

translations.literal: General Who Guards the North, South Yanzhou Inspector Prince Zong of Yuzhang shall marshal the bold heroes, racing forward like the wind;
translations.idiomatic: General Who Guards the North and South Yanzhou inspector Prince Zong of Yuzhang shall marshal the bold heroes and race forward like the wind;

sentences.zh: 其餘衆軍，計日差遣，初中後師，善得嚴辦。

translations.literal: The remaining armies shall be dispatched on fixed days, first, middle, and rear columns all kept in strict readiness.
translations.idiomatic: the remaining armies are to be sent out on fixed days, with first, middle, and rear columns kept in strict readiness.

sentences.zh: 朕當六軍雲動，龍舟濟江。

translations.literal: I myself shall move the Six Armies like gathering clouds, and dragon boats shall cross the river."
translations.idiomatic: I myself shall move the Six Armies like gathering clouds, and dragon boats shall cross the river."

sentences.zh: 」癸酉，剋魏鄭城。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Wei's Zheng city was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Wei's Zheng city was taken.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以魏鎮東將軍、徐州刺史元法僧爲司空。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Wei's General Who Guards the East and Xuzhou Inspector Yuan Faseng was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Wei's General Who Guards the East and Xuzhou inspector Yuan Faseng was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，老人星見。

translations.literal: In the second month, day dingchou, the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day in the second month the Old Man star appeared.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，南徐州刺史廬陵王續還朝，稟承戎略。

translations.literal: On gengchen, South Xuzhou Inspector Prince Xu of Luling returned to court and received the military plan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day South Xuzhou inspector Prince Xu of Luling returned to court to receive the military plan.

sentences.zh: 乙未，趙景悅下魏龍亢城。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Zhao Jingyue took Wei's Longgang city.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Zhao Jingyue took Wei's Longgang city.

sentences.zh: 三月丙午，歲星見南斗。

translations.literal: In the third month, day bingwu, Jupiter appeared in the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day in the third month Jupiter appeared in the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 賜新附民長復除，應諸罪失一無所問。

translations.literal: Newly submitted chiefs of the people were granted tax exemption; all crimes and faults were not to be questioned.
translations.idiomatic: Chiefs among the newly submitted people were granted tax exemption, and all past crimes and faults were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 己酉，行幸白下城，履行六軍頓所。

translations.literal: On jiyou, the emperor traveled to Baixia city and inspected the encampments of the Six Armies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the emperor went to Baixia city and inspected the encampments of the Six Armies.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，鎮北將軍、南兗州刺史豫章王綜權頓彭城，總督衆軍，並攝徐州府事。

translations.literal: On yichou, General Who Guards the North, South Yanzhou Inspector Prince Zong of Yuzhang was temporarily stationed at Pengcheng, commanding all armies and concurrently administering Xuzhou affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day General Who Guards the North and South Yanzhou inspector Prince Zong of Yuzhang was posted at Pengcheng to command all armies and concurrently administer Xuzhou affairs.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以魏假平東將軍元景隆爲衡州刺史，魏征虜將軍元景仲爲廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On jisi, Wei's Acting General Who Pacifies the East Yuan Jinglong was made Hengzhou Inspector, and Wei's General Who Conquers Barbarians Yuan Jingzhong was made Guangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Wei's acting General Who Pacifies the East Yuan Jinglong was made Hengzhou inspector, and Wei's General Who Conquers Barbarians Yuan Jingzhong was made Guangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 夏五月己酉，築宿預堰，又修曹公堰於濟陰。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, day jiyou, the Suyu dam was built, and the Cao Gong dam was repaired in Jiyin.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day in the fifth month of summer the Suyu dam was built and the Cao Gong dam repaired in Jiyin.

sentences.zh: 太白晝見。

translations.literal: Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: Venus was seen in daylight.

sentences.zh: 壬子，遣中護軍夏侯亶督壽陽諸軍事，北伐。

translations.literal: On renzi, Central Army Protector Xiahou Dan was dispatched to oversee military affairs at Shouyang and campaign north.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Central Army Protector Xiahou Dan was sent to command the armies at Shouyang and march north.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰，豫章王綜奔于魏，魏復據彭城。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, day gengchen, Prince Zong of Yuzhang fled to Wei, and Wei again held Pengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day in the sixth month Prince Zong of Yuzhang fled to Wei, and Wei reoccupied Pengcheng.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬戌，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, day renxu, a general amnesty was granted for the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day in the seventh month of autumn a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，以散騎常侍曹仲宗兼領軍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day bingzi, Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary Cao Zongzong was made Concurrent Director of Palace Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day in the eighth month Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary Cao Zongzong was made concurrent Director of Palace Attendants.

sentences.zh: 壬午，老人星見。

translations.literal: On renwu, the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the Old Man star appeared.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子，卲陵王綸有罪，免官，削爵土。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, day wuzi, Prince Lun of Shaoling was guilty of crime, removed from office, and stripped of title and fief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day in the twelfth month Prince Lun of Shaoling was found guilty, removed from office, and stripped of title and fief.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，京師地震。

translations.literal: On renchen, the capital shook with an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月辛丑朔，赦殊死以下。

translations.literal: On the first day of the first month of spring of the seventh year, day xinchou, those guilty below capital punishment were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On the new year, xinchou day in the first month of spring, year 7, all below capital punishment were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，滑國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Huaguo sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Huaguo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，北伐衆軍解嚴。

translations.literal: In the second month, day jiaxu, the northern campaign armies stood down from alert.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day in the second month the northern campaign armies stood down from alert.

sentences.zh: 河南遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Henan sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Henan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，老人星見。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Old Man star appeared.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，高麗國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the third month, day yimao, Goguryeo sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day in the third month Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙酉，太尉臨川王宏薨。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, day yiyou, Grand Preceptor Prince Hong of Linchuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day in the fourth month of summer Grand Preceptor Prince Hong of Linchuan died.

sentences.zh: 南州津改置校尉，增加俸秩。

translations.literal: Crossing officers were established at southern river fords, with increased stipends.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing officers were established at southern river fords, and their stipends were increased.

sentences.zh: 詔在位羣臣，各舉所知，凡是清吏，咸使薦聞，州年舉二人，大郡一人。

translations.literal: An edict ordered all ministers in office, each to recommend those they knew; all upright officials were to be recommended and reported; each province was to nominate two men yearly, each large commandery one.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered every minister in office to recommend those he knew; all upright officials were to be brought forward, with two nominations per province each year and one per large commandery.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，林邑國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, day jimao, Linyi sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day in the sixth month Linyi sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋九月己酉，驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、荊州刺史鄱陽王恢薨。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of autumn, day jiyou, General of Agile Cavalry, Grand General with Staff Equal to the Three Dignities, and Jingzhou Inspector Prince Hui of Poyang died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day in the ninth month of autumn General of Agile Cavalry, Grand General with Staff Equal to the Three Dignities, and Jingzhou inspector Prince Hui of Poyang died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛未，以丹陽尹、湘東王繹爲荊州刺史。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, day xinwei, Danyang Prefect Prince Yi of Xiangdong was made Jingzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day in the tenth month of winter Danyang prefect Prince Yi of Xiangdong was made Jingzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，輿駕幸同泰寺捨身。

translations.literal: In the third month, day xinwei, the imperial carriage went to Tongtai Temple and offered the body in renunciation.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day in the third month the emperor went to Tongtai Temple and offered his body in renunciation.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，還宮，赦天下，改元。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, he returned to the palace, granted a general amnesty, and changed the reign era.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day he returned to the palace, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the reign era.

sentences.zh: 以左衛將軍蕭淵藻爲中護軍。

translations.literal: Left Guard General Xiao Yuanzao was made Central Army Protector.
translations.idiomatic: Left Guard General Xiao Yuanzao was made Central Army Protector.

sentences.zh: 林邑、師子國各遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Linyi and Shizi each sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Linyi and Shizi each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丙寅，成景雋剋魏臨潼竹邑。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, day bingyin, Cheng Jingjuan captured Wei's Lintong and Zhuyi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day in the fifth month of summer Cheng Jingjuan took Wei's Lintong and Zhuyi.

sentences.zh: 秋八月壬辰，老人星見。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, day renchen, the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day in the eighth month of autumn the Old Man star appeared.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚戌，魏東豫州刺史元慶和以渦陽內屬。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, day gengxu, Wei's East Yuzhou Inspector Yuan Qinghe brought Guoyang over to the court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day in the tenth month of winter Wei's East Yuzhou inspector Yuan Qinghe surrendered Guoyang to the court.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，曲赦東豫州。

translations.literal: On jiayin, a partial amnesty was granted for East Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day a partial amnesty was granted for East Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯，以中護軍蕭淵藻爲北討都督、征北大將軍，鎮渦陽。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, day dingmao, Central Army Protector Xiao Yuanzao was made Northern Campaign Commander and General Who Conquers the North, stationed at Guoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day in the eleventh month Central Army Protector Xiao Yuanzao was made Northern Campaign Commander and General Who Conquers the North and stationed at Guoyang.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，加尚書令、中衛將軍、開府儀同三司袁昂中書監。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Director of the Masters of Writing, Central Guard General, and Grand General with Staff Equal to the Three Dignities Yuan Ang was additionally made Director of the Palace Library.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Director of the Masters of Writing, Central Guard General, and Grand General with Staff Equal to the Three Dignities Yuan Ang was additionally made Director of the Palace Library.

sentences.zh: 以渦陽置西徐州。

translations.literal: West Xuzhou was established at Guoyang.
translations.idiomatic: West Xuzhou was established at Guoyang.

sentences.zh: 高麗國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Goguryeo sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月庚申，司空元法僧以本官領中軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, day gengshen, Minister of Works Yuan Faseng, in his existing office, additionally led the Central Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day in the first month of spring, year 2, Minister of Works Yuan Faseng, retaining his existing office, additionally led the Central Army.

sentences.zh: 中書監、尚書令、中衛將軍、開府儀同三司袁昂進號中撫大將軍。

translations.literal: Director of the Palace Library, Director of the Masters of Writing, Central Guard General, and Grand General with Staff Equal to the Three Dignities Yuan Ang was promoted to General Who Pacifies the Center.
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Palace Library, Director of the Masters of Writing, Central Guard General, and Grand General with Staff Equal to the Three Dignities Yuan Ang was promoted to General Who Pacifies the Center.

sentences.zh: 衛尉卿蕭昂爲中領軍。

translations.literal: Minister of the Court of the Palace Guard Xiao Ang was made General Who Leads the Army.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of the Court of the Palace Guard Xiao Ang was made General Who Leads the Army.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，芮芮國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Ruru sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Ruru sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午，老人星見。

translations.literal: In the second month, day jiawu, the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day in the second month the Old Man star appeared.

sentences.zh: 是月，築寒山堰。

translations.literal: That month, the Hanshan dam was built.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Hanshan dam was built.

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌，以江州刺史南康王績爲安右將軍。

translations.literal: In the third month, day renxu, Jiangzhou Inspector Prince Ji of Nankang was made General Who Pacifies the Right.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day in the third month Jiangzhou inspector Prince Ji of Nankang was made General Who Pacifies the Right.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，魏郢州刺史元願達以義陽內附，置北司州。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, day xinchou, Wei's Yingzhou Inspector Yuan Yuanda brought Yiyang over to the court, and North Si province was established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day in the fourth month of summer Wei's Yingzhou inspector Yuan Yuanda surrendered Yiyang to the court, and North Si province was established.

sentences.zh: 時魏大亂，其北海王元顥、臨淮王元彧、汝南王元悅並來奔；

translations.literal: At that time Wei was in great disorder; its Prince Hao of Beihai, Prince Yu of Linhuai, and Prince Yue of Runan all came fleeing;
translations.idiomatic: At that time Wei was in great disorder; Prince Hao of Beihai, Prince Yu of Linhuai, and Prince Yue of Runan all fled to the court;

sentences.zh: 其北青州刺史元世雋、南荊州刺史李志亦以地降。

translations.literal: Its North Qingzhou Inspector Yuan Shijun and South Jingzhou Inspector Li Zhi also surrendered their territories.
translations.idiomatic: and North Qingzhou inspector Yuan Shijun and South Jingzhou inspector Li Zhi also surrendered their territories.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥，魏臨淮王元彧求還本國，許之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, day dinghai, Wei's Prince Yu of Linhuai asked to return to his native state, and permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day in the sixth month Wei's Prince Yu of Linhuai asked to return home, and permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥，以魏北海王元顥爲魏主，遣東宮直閤將軍陳慶之衛送還北。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, day dinghai, Wei's Prince Hao of Beihai was made ruler of Wei, and Eastern Palace Direct Attendant General Chen Qingzhi was dispatched to guard and escort him back north.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day in the tenth month of winter Wei's Prince Hao of Beihai was made ruler of Wei, and Eastern Palace Direct Attendant General Chen Qingzhi was sent to guard and escort him back north.

sentences.zh: 魏豫州刺史鄧獻以地內屬。

translations.literal: Wei's Yuzhou Inspector Deng Xian brought his territory over to the court.
translations.idiomatic: Wei's Yuzhou inspector Deng Xian surrendered his territory to the court.

sentences.zh: 中大通元年正月辛酉，輿駕親祠南郊，大赦天下，孝悌力田賜爵一級。

translations.literal: In the first month of Zhongda Tong year 1, day xinyou, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburbs, a general amnesty was granted for the empire, and filial sons and diligent farmers were granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day in the first month of Zhongda Tong 1 the emperor sacrificed at the Southern Suburbs in person, proclaimed a general amnesty, and granted one rank of nobility to filial sons and diligent farmers.

sentences.zh: 甲子，魏汝南王元悅求還本國，許之。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Wei's Prince Yue of Runan asked to return to his native state, and permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Wei's Prince Yue of Runan asked to return home, and permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，輿駕親祠明堂。

translations.literal: On xinsi, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Hall of Enlightenment.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the emperor sacrificed at the Hall of Enlightenment in person.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申，以丹陽尹武陵王紀爲江州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, day jiashen, Danyang Prefect Prince Ji of Wuling was made Jiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day in the second month Danyang prefect Prince Ji of Wuling was made Jiangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，芮芮國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Ruru sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Ruru sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，以河南王阿羅真爲寧西將軍、西秦、河沙三州刺史。

translations.literal: In the third month, day bingchen, Henan Prince Aluozhen was made General Who Pacifies the West, Inspector of West Qin, He, and Sha provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day in the third month Henan Prince Aluozhen was made General Who Pacifies the West and inspector of West Qin, He, and Sha provinces.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以中護軍蕭淵藻爲中權將軍。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Central Army Protector Xiao Yuanzao was made Central Military General.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Central Army Protector Xiao Yuanzao was made Central Military General.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸未，以安右將軍南康王績爲護軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, day guiwei, General Who Pacifies the Right Prince Ji of Nankang was made Protector General.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day in the fourth month of summer General Who Pacifies the Right Prince Ji of Nankang was made Protector General.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，陳慶之攻魏梁城，拔之，進屠考城，擒魏濟陰王元暉業。

translations.literal: On guisi, Chen Qingzhi attacked Wei's Liang city, took it, advanced and stormed Kaocheng, and captured Wei Prince Yuan Huiye of Jiyin.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Chen Qingzhi attacked Wei's Liang city and took it, then advanced to storm Kaocheng and captured Wei Prince Yuan Huiye of Jiyin.

sentences.zh: 五月戊辰，剋大梁。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, day wuchen, Daliang was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day in the fifth month Daliang was taken.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，剋虎牢城。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Hulao city was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Hulao city was taken.

sentences.zh: 魏主元子攸棄洛陽，走河北。

translations.literal: Wei's ruler Yuan Ziyou abandoned Luoyang and fled to Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: Wei's ruler Yuan Ziyou abandoned Luoyang and fled north to Hebei.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，元顥入洛陽。

translations.literal: On yihai, Yuan Hao entered Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Yuan Hao entered Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on day renwu, a general amnesty was granted for the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day in the sixth month a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，魏淮陰太守晉鴻以湖陽城內屬。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Wei's Huaiyin Administrator Jin Hong brought Huyang city within the border.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Wei's Huaiyin administrator Jin Hong surrendered Huyang city to the court.

sentences.zh: 閏月己未，安右將軍、護軍南康王績薨。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on day jiwei, General of the Right for Administration, Army Protector, Prince Ji of Nankang died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day in the intercalary month General of the Right for Administration, army protector, Prince Ji of Nankang died.

sentences.zh: 己卯，魏尒朱榮攻殺元顥，復據洛陽。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Wei's Erzhu Rong attacked and killed Yuan Hao and again held Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Wei's Erzhu Rong attacked and killed Yuan Hao and reoccupied Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 秋九月辛巳，朱雀航華表災。

translations.literal: In autumn, the ninth month, on day xinsi, the ornamental pillar at Zhuque Bridge was destroyed by fire.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day in the ninth month of autumn the ornamental pillar at Zhuque Bridge burned.

sentences.zh: 以安北將軍羊侃爲青、冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the North Yang Kan was made Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Pacifies the North Yang Kan was made inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，輿駕幸同泰寺，設四部無遮大會，因捨身，公卿以下，以錢一億萬奉贖。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the imperial carriage went to Tongtai Temple, established a four-section unrestricted great assembly, and thereupon offered the body in renunciation; officials from dukes and ministers downward offered one hundred million in coin to ransom him.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the emperor went to Tongtai Temple, opened a four-section unrestricted great assembly, and offered his body in renunciation; from dukes and ministers downward all contributed one hundred million in coin to ransom him.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己酉，輿駕還宮，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on day jiyou, the imperial carriage returned to the palace, granted a general amnesty, and changed the reign era.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day in the tenth month of winter the emperor returned to the palace, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the reign era.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，加中撫大將軍、開府儀同三司袁昂中書監。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on day bingxu, Grand General Who Pacifies the Center, Grand General with Staff Equal to the Three Dignities Yuan Ang was additionally made Director of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day in the eleventh month Grand General Who Pacifies the Center Yuan Ang, Grand General with Staff Equal to the Three Dignities, was additionally made Director of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 加鎮衛大將軍、開府儀同三司南平王偉太子少傅。

translations.literal: Grand General Who Guards the Capital, Grand General with Staff Equal to the Three Dignities Prince Wei of Nanping was additionally made Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: Grand General Who Guards the Capital Prince Wei of Nanping, Grand General with Staff Equal to the Three Dignities, was additionally made Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 加金紫光祿大夫蕭琛、陸杲並特進。

translations.literal: Grand Masters for Golden Seal and Purple Sash Xiao Chen and Lu Gao were both promoted to Special Advancement.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Masters for Golden Seal and Purple Sash Xiao Chen and Lu Gao were both promoted to Special Advancement.

sentences.zh: 司空、中軍將軍元法僧進號車騎將軍。

translations.literal: Minister of Works, Central Army General Yuan Faseng was promoted to General of Chariots and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works and Central Army General Yuan Faseng was promoted to General of Chariots and Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 中權將軍蕭淵藻爲中護軍將軍。

translations.literal: General of the Interior Guard Xiao Yuanzao was made General of the Central Guard.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Interior Guard Xiao Yuanzao was made General of the Central Guard.

sentences.zh: 中領軍蕭昂爲領軍將軍。

translations.literal: Central Army Commander Xiao Ang was made Army Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Central army commander Xiao Ang was made army commander.

sentences.zh: 戊子，魏巴州刺史嚴始欣以城降。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Wei's Bazhou Inspector Yan Shixin surrendered his city.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Wei's Bazhou inspector Yan Shixin surrendered his city.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，盤盤國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on day dingsi, the kingdom of Panpan sent envoys offering local products.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day in the twelfth month Panpan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月戊寅，以雍州刺史晉安王綱爲驃騎大將軍、揚州刺史，南徐州刺史廬陵王續爲平北將軍、雍州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on day wuyin, Yongzhou Inspector Prince Gang of Jin'an was made Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Yangzhou Inspector; South Xuzhou Inspector Prince Xu of Luling was made General Who Pacifies the North and Yongzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day in the first month of spring, year 2, Yongzhou inspector Prince Gang of Jin'an was made Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Yangzhou inspector, and South Xuzhou inspector Prince Xu of Luling was made General Who Pacifies the North and Yongzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 癸未，老人星見。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day the Old Man star appeared.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申，大雨雹。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on day gengshen, great hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day in the fourth month of summer heavy hail fell.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以河南王佛輔爲寧西將軍、西秦、河二州刺史。

translations.literal: On day renshen, King of Henan Fofu was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of West Qin and He provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day King of Henan Fofu was made General Who Pacifies the West and inspector of West Qin and He provinces.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，遣魏太保汝南王元悅還北爲魏主。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on day dingsi, Wei's Grand Tutor Prince Yue of Runan was dispatched back north to serve as Wei's ruler.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day in the sixth month Wei's Grand Tutor Prince Yue of Runan was sent back north to reign over Wei.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以魏尚書左僕射范遵爲安北將軍、司州牧，隨元悅北討。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Wei's Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Fan Zun was made General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Si province, accompanying Yuan Yue north to campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Wei's Left Vice Director Fan Zun was made General Who Pacifies the North and governor of Si province and marched north with Yuan Yue.

sentences.zh: 林邑國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The kingdom of Linyi sent envoys offering local products.
translations.idiomatic: Linyi sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬申，扶南國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the kingdom of Funan sent envoys offering local products.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Funan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋八月庚戌，輿駕幸德陽堂，設絲竹會，祖送魏主元悅。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on day gengxu, the imperial carriage went to Deyang Hall, held a music assembly, and saw off Wei's ruler Yuan Yue with a farewell banquet.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day in the eighth month of autumn the emperor went to Deyang Hall, held a music assembly, and gave a farewell banquet for Wei's ruler Yuan Yue.

sentences.zh: 山賊聚結，寇會稽郡所部縣。

translations.literal: Mountain bandits gathered, raiding the counties under Kuaiji commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Mountain bandits gathered and raided the counties under Kuaiji commandery.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，假超武將軍湛海珍節以討之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on day renwu, acting Superlative Martial General Zhan Haizhen was given a tally of authority to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day in the ninth month acting Superlative Martial General Zhan Haizhen was given command authority to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月辛巳，輿駕親祠南郊，大赦天下，孝悌力田賜爵一級。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on day xinsi, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburbs, granted a general amnesty for the empire, and filial sons, obedient brothers, and diligent farmers were granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day in the first month of spring, year 3, the emperor sacrificed at the Southern Suburbs in person, proclaimed a general amnesty, and granted one rank of nobility to filial sons, obedient brothers, and diligent farmers.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以魏尚書僕射鄭先護爲征北大將軍。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Wei's Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Zheng Xianhu was made Grand General Who Conquers the North.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Wei's Vice Director Zheng Xianhu was made Grand General Who Conquers the North.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，輿駕親祠明堂。

translations.literal: In the second month, on day xinchou, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Hall of Enlightenment.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day in the second month the emperor sacrificed at the Hall of Enlightenment in person.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，老人星見。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Old Man star appeared.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，特進蕭琛卒。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Special Advancement Xiao Chen died.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Special Advancement Xiao Chen died.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以廣州刺史元景隆爲安右將軍。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Guangzhou Inspector Yuan Jinglong was made General of the Right for Administration.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Guangzhou inspector Yuan Jinglong was made General of the Right for Administration.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙巳，皇太子統薨。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on day yisi, Crown Prince Tong died.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day in the fourth month of summer Crown Prince Tong died.

sentences.zh: 六月丁未，以前太子詹事蕭淵猷爲中護軍。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on day dingwei, former Crown Prince Mentor Xiao Yuanyou was made General of the Central Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day in the sixth month former Crown Prince Mentor Xiao Yuanyou was made General of the Central Guard.

sentences.zh: 尚書僕射徐勉加特進、右光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Xu Mian was additionally made Special Advancement and Grand Master for Golden Seal Serving at the Right.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director Xu Mian was additionally made Special Advancement and Right Grand Master for Golden Seal.

sentences.zh: 丹丹國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The kingdom of Dandan sent envoys offering local products.
translations.idiomatic: Dandan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，立昭明太子子南徐州刺史華容公歡爲豫章郡王，枝江公譽爲河東郡王，曲阿公察爲岳陽郡王。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Crown Prince Zhaoming's son Duke of Huarong Huan, South Xuzhou Inspector, was made Prince of Yuzhang commandery; Duke of Zhijiang Yu was made Prince of Hedong commandery; and Duke of Qu'e Cha was made Prince of Yueyang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Crown Prince Zhaoming's son Huan, Duke of Huarong and South Xuzhou inspector, was made Prince of Yuzhang commandery; Yu, Duke of Zhijiang, was made Prince of Hedong commandery; and Cha, Duke of Qu'e, was made Prince of Yueyang commandery.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙亥，立晉安王綱爲皇太子。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on day yihai, Prince Gang of Jin'an was made Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day in the seventh month of autumn Prince Gang of Jin'an was made Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，賜爲父後者及出處忠孝文武清勤，並賜爵一級。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was granted for the empire; heirs who succeeded their fathers and those who showed loyalty, filial piety, martial and civil merit, cleanness, and diligence in service were all granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed; heirs who succeeded their fathers and those who had served with loyalty, filial piety, martial and civil merit, integrity, and diligence all received one rank of nobility.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以侍中、五兵尚書謝舉爲吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Palace Attendant and Minister of the Five Armies Xie Ju was made Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Palace Attendant and Minister of the Five Armies Xie Ju was made Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔曰：「推恩六親，義彰九族，班以侯爵，亦曰惟允。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, an edict said: "Extending grace to the six relations, righteousness displayed among the nine kin-groups, bestowing marquisates in rank—this too is fitting.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day an edict said, "To extend grace to the six relations, make righteousness shine among the nine kin-groups, and bestow marquisates in rank is only fitting.

sentences.zh: 凡是宗戚有服屬者，並可賜沐食鄉亭侯，各隨遠近以爲差次。

translations.literal: All imperial clansmen within mourning obligations may be granted fief-income Marquis of the Village and Pavilion, each in descending order according to nearness or distance.
translations.idiomatic: All clansmen within the prescribed degrees of mourning may receive fief-income as Marquis of the Village and Pavilion, graded by nearness or distance.

sentences.zh: 其有昵親，自依舊章。

translations.literal: As for close intimates, the old regulations shall apply.
translations.idiomatic: For close intimates, the old regulations still apply.

sentences.zh: 」壬辰，以吏部尚書何敬容爲尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: " On day renchen, Minister of Personnel He Jingrong was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: " On renchen day Minister of Personnel He Jingrong was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，老人星見。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the Old Man star appeared.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午，以太子詹事蕭淵藻爲征北將軍、南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on day gengwu, Crown Prince Mentor Xiao Yuanzao was made General Who Conquers the North and South Yanzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day in the ninth month Crown Prince Mentor Xiao Yuanzao was made General Who Conquers the North and South Yanzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，狼牙脩國奉表獻方物。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Langyaxiu submitted a memorial offering local products.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Langyaxiu submitted a memorial with tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己酉，行幸同泰寺，高祖升法座，爲四部衆說《大般若涅盤經》義，迄于乙卯。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on day jiyou, the court went to Tongtai Temple; Gaozu ascended the dharma seat and expounded the meaning of the Mahaparinirvana Sutra for the four assemblies, continuing until day yimao.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day in the tenth month of winter the court went to Tongtai Temple; Gaozu took the dharma seat and expounded the Mahaparinirvana Sutra for the four assemblies, continuing until yimao day.

sentences.zh: 前樂山縣侯蕭正則有罪流徙，至是招誘亡命，欲寇廣州，在所討平之。

translations.literal: Former Marquis of Leshan county Xiao Zhengze, having been exiled for crime, now gathered fugitives and sought to raid Guangzhou; local forces suppressed and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: Former Marquis of Leshan county Xiao Zhengze, exiled for crime, now gathered fugitives and sought to raid Guangzhou; local forces crushed and pacified him.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未，行幸同泰寺，高祖升法座，爲四部從說《摩訶般若波羅蜜經》義，訖于十二月辛丑。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on day yiwei, the court went to Tongtai Temple; Gaozu ascended the dharma seat and continued expounding the meaning of the Mahaprajnaparamita Sutra until xinchou day in the twelfth month.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day in the eleventh month the court went to Tongtai Temple; Gaozu took the dharma seat and continued expounding the Mahaprajnaparamita Sutra until xinchou day in the twelfth month.

sentences.zh: 是歲，吳興郡生野穀，堪食。

translations.literal: That year, Wuxing commandery produced wild grain fit to eat.
translations.idiomatic: That year Wuxing commandery produced wild grain fit for food.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丙寅朔，以鎮衛大將軍、開府儀同三司南平王偉進位大司馬，司空元法僧進太尉，尚書令、中權大將軍、開府儀同三司袁昂進位司空。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on the first day bingyin, Grand General Who Guards the Capital, Grand General with Staff Equal to the Three Dignities Prince Wei of Nanping was promoted to Grand Marshal; Minister of Works Yuan Faseng was promoted to Grand Preceptor; Director of the Masters of Writing, General of the Interior Guard, Grand General with Staff Equal to the Three Dignities Yuan Ang was promoted to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, the new moon of the first month of spring, year 4, Prince Wei of Nanping was promoted to Grand Marshal; Yuan Faseng from Minister of Works to Grand Preceptor; and Yuan Ang, Director of the Masters of Writing and General of the Interior Guard, to Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 立臨川靖惠王宏子正德爲臨賀郡王。

translations.literal: Prince Zhengde, son of Prince Hong of Linchuan Jinghui, was made Prince of Linhe commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde, son of Prince Hong of Linchuan Jinghui, was made Prince of Linhe commandery.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以丹陽尹卲陵王綸爲揚州刺史。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Danyang Prefect Prince Lun of Shaoling was made Yangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Danyang prefect Prince Lun of Shaoling was made Yangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 太子右衛率薛法護爲平北將軍、司州牧，衛送元悅入洛。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Right Guard Leader Xue Fahu was made General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Si province, guarding and escorting Yuan Yue into Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Right Guard Leader Xue Fahu was made General Who Pacifies the North and governor of Si province to guard and escort Yuan Yue into Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 庚午，立嫡皇孫大器爲宣城郡王。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, legitimate imperial grandson Daqi was made Prince of Xuancheng commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day legitimate imperial grandson Daqi was made Prince of Xuancheng commandery.

sentences.zh: 癸未，魏南兗州刺史劉世明以城降，改魏南兗州爲譙州，以世明爲刺史。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Wei's South Yanzhou Inspector Liu Shiming surrendered his city; Wei's South Yanzhou was changed to Qiao province, and Shiming was made inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Wei's South Yanzhou inspector Liu Shiming surrendered his city; South Yanzhou was renamed Qiao province and Shiming was made its inspector.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅，老人星見。

translations.literal: In the second month, on day renyin, the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day in the second month the Old Man star appeared.

sentences.zh: 新除太尉元法僧還北，爲東魏主。

translations.literal: Newly appointed Grand Preceptor Yuan Faseng returned north to become ruler of Eastern Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Newly appointed Grand Preceptor Yuan Faseng returned north to reign as ruler of Eastern Wei.

sentences.zh: 以安右將軍元景隆爲征北將軍、徐州刺史，雲麾將軍羊侃爲安北將軍、兗州刺史，散騎常侍元樹爲鎮北將軍。

translations.literal: General of the Right for Administration Yuan Jinglong was made General Who Conquers the North and Xuzhou Inspector; Cloud Banner General Yang Kan was made General Who Pacifies the North and Yanzhou Inspector; Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary Yuan Shu was made General Who Guards the North.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Right for Administration Yuan Jinglong was made General Who Conquers the North and Xuzhou inspector; Cloud Banner General Yang Kan was made General Who Pacifies the North and Yanzhou inspector; and Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary Yuan Shu was made General Who Guards the North.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，新除揚州刺史卲陵王綸有罪，免爲庶人。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, newly appointed Yangzhou Inspector Prince Lun of Shaoling was guilty of crime and demoted to commoner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day newly appointed Yangzhou inspector Prince Lun of Shaoling was found guilty and reduced to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以江州刺史武陵王紀爲揚州刺史，領軍將軍蕭昂爲江州刺史。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Jiangzhou Inspector Prince Ji of Wuling was made Yangzhou Inspector; Army Commander Xiao Ang was made Jiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Jiangzhou inspector Prince Ji of Wuling was made Yangzhou inspector, and army commander Xiao Ang was made Jiangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，卲陵縣獲白鹿一。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Shaoling county captured one white deer.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Shaoling county captured a white deer.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午，侍中、領國子博士蕭子顯上表置制旨《孝經》助教一人，生十人，專通高祖所釋《孝經義》。

translations.literal: In the third month, on day gengwu, Palace Attendant and Director of the Imperial Academy Xiao Zixian memorialized to establish one assistant instructor for the imperial commentary Filial Piety Classic, with ten students devoted to mastering Gaozu's exposition of the Filial Piety Meanings.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day in the third month Palace Attendant and Director of the Imperial Academy Xiao Zixian memorialized to appoint one assistant instructor for the imperial Filial Piety Classic, with ten students devoted to Gaozu's exposition of its meanings.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬申，盤盤國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on day renshen, the kingdom of Panpan sent envoys offering local products.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day in the fourth month of summer Panpan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，星隕如雨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on day jiachen, stars fell like rain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day in the seventh month of autumn stars fell like rain.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，特進陸杲卒。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on day bingzi, Special Advancement Lu Gao died.
