translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day in the eighth month Special Advancement Lu Gao died.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳，以太子詹事南平王世子恪爲領軍將軍，平北將軍、雍州刺史廬陵王續爲安北將軍，西中郎將、荊州刺史湘東王繹爲平西將軍，司空袁昂領尚書令。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on day yisi, Crown Prince Mentor and Heir of Nanping Prince Ke was made Army Commander; General Who Pacifies the North and Yongzhou Inspector Prince Xu of Luling was made General Who Pacifies the North; Western Central Commander and Jingzhou Inspector Prince Yi of Xiangdong was made General Who Pacifies the West; and Minister of Works Yuan Ang additionally held the directorship of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day in the ninth month Crown Prince Mentor Ke, heir of Prince of Nanping, was made army commander; General Who Pacifies the North Prince Xu of Luling, Yongzhou inspector, was made General Who Pacifies the North; Western Central Commander Prince Yi of Xiangdong, Jingzhou inspector, was made General Who Pacifies the West; and Minister of Works Yuan Ang additionally held the directorship of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 十一月己酉，高麗國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on day jiyou, the kingdom of Goguryeo sent envoys offering local products.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day in the eleventh month Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰，以太尉元法僧爲驃騎大將軍、開府同三司之儀、郢州刺史。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on day gengchen, Grand Preceptor Yuan Faseng was made Grand General of Agile Cavalry, with staff equal to the Three Dignities, and Yingzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day in the twelfth month Grand Preceptor Yuan Faseng was made Grand General of Agile Cavalry with staff equal to the Three Dignities and Yingzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月辛卯，輿駕親祠南郊，大赦天下，孝悌力田賜爵一級。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on day xinmao, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburbs, granted a general amnesty for the empire, and filial sons, obedient brothers, and diligent farmers were granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day in the first month of spring, year 5, the emperor sacrificed at the Southern Suburbs in person, proclaimed a general amnesty, and granted one rank of nobility to filial sons, obedient brothers, and diligent farmers.

sentences.zh: 先是一日丙夜，南郊令解滌之等到郊所履行，忽聞空中有異香三隨風至，及將行事，奏樂迎神畢，有神光滿壇上，硃紫黃白雜色，食頃方滅。

translations.literal: The night before, on bing eve, Director of the Southern Suburbs Xie Dizhi and others went to inspect the suburban site; suddenly they heard strange fragrance three times wafting on the wind, and when the rites were about to begin and the music welcoming the spirits had finished, divine light filled the altar in red, purple, yellow, and white mixed colors, lasting about the time to eat a meal before vanishing.
translations.idiomatic: On the eve before, at the third watch of bing night, Director of the Southern Suburbs Xie Dizhi and others inspected the ritual ground and suddenly smelled strange fragrance three times on the wind; when the rites were about to begin and the music welcoming the spirits had ended, divine light filled the altar in red, purple, yellow, and white, lingering for the time of a meal before fading.

sentences.zh: 兼太宰武陵王紀等以聞。

translations.literal: Concurrent Grand Preceptor Prince Ji of Wuling and others reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Concurrent Grand Preceptor Prince Ji of Wuling and others reported the omen.

sentences.zh: 戊申，京師地震。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the capital shook with an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 己酉。

translations.literal: On day jiyou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day,

sentences.zh: 長星見。

translations.literal: A broom star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: a broom star was seen.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，輿駕親祠明堂。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Hall of Enlightenment.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the emperor sacrificed at the Hall of Enlightenment in person.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以宣城王大器爲中軍將軍。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Prince Daqi of Xuancheng was made Central Army General.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Prince Daqi of Xuancheng was made Central Army General.

sentences.zh: 河南國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The kingdom of Henan sent envoys offering local products.
translations.idiomatic: Henan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月癸未，行幸同泰寺，設四部大會，高祖升法座，發《金字摩訶波若經》題，訖于己丑。

translations.literal: In the second month, on day guiwei, the court went to Tongtai Temple, held a four-section great assembly, and Gaozu ascended the dharma seat to open the lecture on the Gold-letter Mahaprajnaparamita Sutra, continuing until day jichou.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day in the second month the court went to Tongtai Temple and held a four-section great assembly; Gaozu took the dharma seat and opened the Gold-letter Mahaprajnaparamita Sutra, continuing until jichou day.

sentences.zh: 老人星見。

translations.literal: The Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: The Old Man star was seen.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，大司馬南平王偉薨。

translations.literal: In the third month, on day bingchen, Grand Marshal Prince Wei of Nanping died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day in the third month Grand Marshal Prince Wei of Nanping died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉，以御史中丞臧盾兼領軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on day guiyou, Censor-in-Chief Zang Dun was made concurrent Army Commander.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day in the fourth month of summer Censor-in-Chief Zang Dun was made concurrent army commander.

sentences.zh: 五月戊子，京邑大水，御道通船。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on day wuzi, the capital flooded; the imperial thoroughfare was navigable by boat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day in the fifth month the capital flooded and boats could pass along the imperial thoroughfare.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，魏建義城主蘭寶殺魏東徐州刺史，以下邳城降。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on day jimao, Wei Jianyi city chief Lan Bao killed Wei's East Xuzhou Inspector and surrendered Xiapi city.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day in the sixth month Wei Jianyi city chief Lan Bao killed Wei's East Xuzhou inspector and surrendered Xiapi city.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛卯，改下邳爲武州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on day xinmao, Xiapi was changed to Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day in the seventh month of autumn Xiapi was renamed Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月庚申，以前徐州刺史元景隆爲安右將軍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on day gengshen, former Xuzhou Inspector Yuan Jinglong was made General of the Right for Administration.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day in the eighth month former Xuzhou inspector Yuan Jinglong was made General of the Right for Administration.

sentences.zh: 老人星見。

translations.literal: The Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: The Old Man star was seen.

sentences.zh: 甲子，波斯國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the kingdom of Persia sent envoys offering local products.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Persia sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲申，中護軍蕭淵猷卒。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, General of the Central Guard Xiao Yuanyou died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day General of the Central Guard Xiao Yuanyou died.

sentences.zh: 九月己亥，以輕車將軍、臨賀王正德爲中護軍。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on day jihai, Light Chariot General Prince Zhengde of Linhe was made General of the Central Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day in the ninth month Light Chariot General Prince Zhengde of Linhe was made General of the Central Guard.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以尚書令、司空袁昂爲特進、左光祿大夫，司空如故。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Director of the Masters of Writing and Minister of Works Yuan Ang was made Special Advancement and Grand Master for Golden Seal Serving at the Left, retaining the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Director of the Masters of Writing and Minister of Works Yuan Ang was made Special Advancement and Left Grand Master for Golden Seal, retaining the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 盤盤國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The kingdom of Panpan sent envoys offering local products.
translations.idiomatic: Panpan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚申，以尚書右僕射何敬容爲尚書左僕射，吏部尚書謝舉爲尚書右僕射，侍中、國子祭酒蕭子顯爲吏部尚書。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on day gengshen, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing He Jingrong was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Minister of Personnel Xie Ju was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; and Palace Attendant and Director of the Imperial Academy Xiao Zixian was made Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day in the tenth month of winter Right Vice Director He Jingrong was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Minister of Personnel Xie Ju was made Right Vice Director; and Palace Attendant and Director of the Imperial Academy Xiao Zixian was made Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 六年春二月癸亥，輿駕親耕籍田，大赦天下，孝悌力田賜爵一級。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, spring, second month, on day guihai, the imperial carriage personally plowed the sacred field, granted a general amnesty for the empire, and filial sons, obedient brothers, and diligent farmers were granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day in the second month of spring, year 6, the emperor plowed the sacred field in person, proclaimed a general amnesty, and granted one rank of nobility to filial sons, obedient brothers, and diligent farmers.

sentences.zh: 三月己亥，以行河南王可遝振爲西秦、河二州刺史、河南王。

translations.literal: In the third month, on day jihai, Acting King of Henan Kedazhen was made Inspector of West Qin and He provinces and King of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day in the third month Acting King of Henan Kedazhen was made inspector of West Qin and He provinces and King of Henan.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，百濟國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, the kingdom of Baekje sent envoys offering local products.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Baekje sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁卯，熒惑在南斗。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on day dingmao, Mars was in the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day in the fourth month of summer Mars stood in the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，林邑國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on day jiachen, the kingdom of Linyi sent envoys offering local products.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day in the seventh month of autumn Linyi sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月己未，以南梁州刺史武興王楊紹先爲秦、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day jiwei, Prince of Wuxing Yang Shaoxian, Southern Liangzhou inspector, was made inspector of Qin and Southern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day in the eighth month, Prince of Wuxing Yang Shaoxian, inspector of Southern Liangzhou, was made inspector of Qin and Southern Qin.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁卯，以信武將軍元慶和爲鎮北將軍，率衆北伐。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, day dingmao, Trustworthy Martial General Yuan Qinghe was made General Who Pacifies the North and led troops on the northern expedition.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day in the tenth month of winter, Trustworthy Martial General Yuan Qinghe became General Who Pacifies the North and marched north at the head of the army.

sentences.zh: 閏十二月丙午，西南有雷聲二。

translations.literal: In the intercalary twelfth month, day bingwu, thunder sounded twice in the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day in the intercalary twelfth month, thunder rolled twice from the southwest.

sentences.zh: 大同元年春正月戊申朔，改元，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the first year of Datong, spring, first month, day wushen new moon, the era name was changed and a general amnesty granted for the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen new moon of the first month in Datong 1, the era name was changed and the empire received a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，老人星見。

translations.literal: In the second month, day jimao, the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day in the second month, the Old Man star appeared.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，輿駕親祠明堂。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, the imperial carriage personally performed sacrifice at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the emperor sacrificed at the Bright Hall in person.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，輿駕躬耕籍田。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the imperial carriage personally plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the emperor plowed the sacred field in person.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，高麗國、丹丹國各遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Goguryeo and Dandan each sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Goguryeo and Dandan each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，滑國王安樂薩丹王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the third month, day xinwei, the King of Huole, King Andle Sadan, sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day in the third month, King Andle Sadan of Huole sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚子，波斯國獻方物。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, day gengzi, Persia presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day in the fourth month of summer, Persia sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以魏鎮東將軍劉濟爲徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Wei General Who Guards the East Liu Ji was made Xuzhou inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Wei General Who Guards the East Liu Ji was made inspector of Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以安北將軍廬陵王續爲安南將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: On day renxu, General Who Pacifies the North, Prince of Luling Xu, was made General Who Pacifies the South and Jiangzhou inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day General Who Pacifies the North, Prince of Luling Xu, became General Who Pacifies the South and inspector of Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙卯，老人星見。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, day yimao, the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day in the seventh month of autumn, the Old Man star appeared.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，扶南國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Funan sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Funan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯，以前南兗州刺史蕭淵藻爲護軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, day xinmao, former South Yanzhou inspector Xiao Yuanzao was made Guard Army General.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day in the tenth month of winter, former South Yanzhou inspector Xiao Yuanzao was made Guard Army General.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁未，中衛將軍、特進、右光祿大夫徐勉卒。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, day dingwei, Central Guard General, Special Advancement, Right Grand Master of Brilliant Happiness Xu Mian died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day in the eleventh month, Central Guard General Xu Mian, Special Advancement and Right Grand Master of Brilliant Happiness, died.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，北梁州刺史蘭欽攻漢中，剋之，魏梁州刺史元羅降。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Northern Liangzhou inspector Lan Qin attacked Hanzhong, took it, and Wei Liangzhou inspector Yuan Luo surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Northern Liangzhou inspector Lan Qin attacked Hanzhong, captured it, and Wei Liangzhou inspector Yuan Luo surrendered.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，賜梁州歸附者復除有差。

translations.literal: On day guihai, those who submitted in Liang province were granted exemptions according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day those who came over in Liang province received graded tax exemptions.

sentences.zh: 甲子，雄勇將軍、北益州刺史陰平王楊法深進號平北將軍。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Valiant General, Prince of Yinping Yang Fashen, Northern Yizhou inspector, was promoted to General Who Pacifies the North.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Valiant General Yang Fashen, Prince of Yinping and inspector of Northern Yizhou, was promoted to General Who Pacifies the North.

sentences.zh: 月行左角星。

translations.literal: The moon passed the Left Horn star.
translations.idiomatic: The moon crossed the Left Horn star.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉，以魏北徐州刺史羊徽逸爲平北將軍。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, day yiyou, Wei Northern Xuzhou inspector Yang Huiyi was made General Who Pacifies the North.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day in the twelfth month, Wei Northern Xuzhou inspector Yang Huiyi was made General Who Pacifies the North.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以平西將軍、秦、南秦二州刺史武興王楊紹先進號車騎將軍、平北將軍、北益州刺史陰平王楊法深進號驃騎將軍。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, General Who Pacifies the West and Qin and Southern Qin inspector Prince of Wuxing Yang Shaoxian was promoted to Chariots and Cavalry General; General Who Pacifies the North and Northern Yizhou inspector Prince of Yinping Yang Fashen was promoted to Flying Cavalry General.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day General Who Pacifies the West Yang Shaoxian, Prince of Wuxing and inspector of Qin and Southern Qin, was promoted to Chariots and Cavalry General, and General Who Pacifies the North Yang Fashen, Prince of Yinping and inspector of Northern Yizhou, was promoted to Flying Cavalry General.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，平西將軍、荊州刺史湘東王繹進號安西將軍。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, General Who Pacifies the West, Jingzhou inspector Prince Yi of Xiangdong was promoted to General Who Secures the West.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day General Who Pacifies the West, Prince Yi of Xiangdong, inspector of Jingzhou, was promoted to General Who Secures the West.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月甲辰，以兼領軍臧盾爲中領軍。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, day jiachen, acting Colonel Director of Retainers Zang Dun was made Colonel Director of Retainers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day in the first month of spring, year 2, acting Colonel Director of Retainers Zang Dun was confirmed as Colonel Director of Retainers.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，輿駕躬耕籍田。

translations.literal: In the second month, day yihai, the imperial carriage personally plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day in the second month the emperor plowed the sacred field in person.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，老人星見。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the Old Man star appeared.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，詔曰：「政在養民，德存被物，上令如風，民應如草。

translations.literal: In the third month, day gengshen, an edict said: "Government lies in nurturing the people; virtue extends to covering all things; commands from above are like wind, the people respond like grass.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day in the third month an edict declared: "To govern is to nourish the people; virtue spreads over all things; the command from above is wind, and the people bend like grass.

sentences.zh: 朕以寡德，運屬時來，撥亂反正，倏焉三紀。

translations.literal: I am scant in virtue; fortune came in its season; I turned disorder to order—and suddenly three decades have passed.
translations.idiomatic: My virtue is slight; fortune came when the hour demanded it; I set chaos right—and in a breath three decades are gone.

sentences.zh: 不能使重門不閉，守在海外，疆埸多阻，車書未一。

translations.literal: I have not made the gates stand open without closing, guards unnecessary beyond the borders; frontiers remain blocked, chariots and writing not yet unified.
translations.idiomatic: I have not brought the realm to the age when gates need never shut and guards need not stand beyond the seas; frontiers still divide us, and chariots and script are not yet one.

sentences.zh: 民疲轉輸，士勞邊防。

translations.literal: The people weary from transport; soldiers toil at the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The people are worn down by transport, and soldiers labor on the borders.

sentences.zh: 徹田爲糧，未得頓止。

translations.literal: Fields are stripped for grain, and there is no halt.
translations.idiomatic: Fields are emptied for grain, and the burden will not stop.

sentences.zh: 治道不明，政用多僻，百辟無沃心之言，四聰闕飛耳之聽，州輟刺舉，郡忘共治。

translations.literal: The way of governance is unclear, policy often perverse; the hundred officials offer no heart-nourishing words, the four listeners lack flying-ear hearing; provinces cease examination, commanderies forget joint rule.
translations.idiomatic: The path of rule is dim and policy often turns crooked; the hundred ministers give no counsel that nourishes the heart, the four listeners hear with no flying ear; provinces stop their inspections, and commanderies forget to govern together.

sentences.zh: 致使失理負謗，無由聞達。

translations.literal: Thus wrongs and blame go unheard.
translations.idiomatic: Wrong and blame pile up with no way to reach me.

sentences.zh: 侮文弄法，因事生姦，肺石空陳，懸鐘徒設。

translations.literal: Law is mocked and twisted, wrongs bred from affairs; the petition stone stands empty, the complaint bell hangs idle.
translations.idiomatic: Men mock the written law and twist it to their ends; the petition stone stands bare, the complaint bell rings to no one.

sentences.zh: 《書》不云乎：『股肱惟人，良臣惟聖。

translations.literal: Does not the Book say: "The limbs and thighs are men; worthy ministers make the sage."
translations.idiomatic: Does not the Book say, "The arms and legs are men; worthy ministers make the sage"?

sentences.zh: 』實賴賢佐，匡其不及。

translations.literal: Truly we rely on worthy aides to remedy our failures.
translations.idiomatic: I truly depend on worthy assistants to mend what I lack.

sentences.zh: 凡厥在朝，各獻讜言，政治不便於民者，可悉陳之。

translations.literal: All in court, each offer loyal counsel; whatever policy is inconvenient to the people—lay it all out.
translations.idiomatic: All who stand in court, each speak your loyal mind; every policy that harms the people, lay it out in full.

sentences.zh: 若在四遠，刺史二千石長吏，並以奏聞。

translations.literal: If far away, inspectors and two-thousand-bushel commandery chiefs shall all memorialize.
translations.idiomatic: If you are far off, inspectors and commandery chiefs of two-thousand-bushel rank shall all report upward.

sentences.zh: 細民有言事者，咸爲申達。

translations.literal: Common people with grievances—all shall be transmitted.
translations.idiomatic: If common people have words to speak, transmit them all.

sentences.zh: 朕將親覽，以紓其過。

translations.literal: I will personally review and ease their suffering.
translations.idiomatic: I will read them myself and ease what is wrong.

sentences.zh: 文武在位，舉爾所知，公侯將相，隨才擢用，拾遺補闕，勿有所隱。」

translations.literal: Civil and military in office—recommend what you know; dukes, marquises, generals, ministers—employ by talent; fill gaps and mend omissions; hide nothing."
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officers in post, recommend those you know; dukes, marquises, generals, and ministers, appoint by talent; fill what is missing and mend what is broken; conceal nothing."

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未，以驃騎大將軍、開府同三司之儀元法僧爲太尉，領軍師將軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, day yimao, Flying Cavalry Grand General Yuan Faseng, with open office and third-rank ceremonial parity, was made Grand Commandant and Grand Army General.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day in the fourth month of summer, Flying Cavalry Grand General Yuan Faseng, with an open office and third-rank ceremonial parity, was made Grand Commandant and Grand Army General.

sentences.zh: 先是，尚書右丞江子四上封事，極言政治得失。

translations.literal: Earlier, Right Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing Jiang Zisi submitted a sealed memorial, speaking fully of the gains and losses in governance.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Right Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing Jiang Zisi submitted a sealed memorial that laid out the gains and losses of government in full.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，詔曰：「古人有言，屋漏在上，知之在下。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, day guimao, an edict said: "The ancients said: leaks in the roof above—the knowledge lies below.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day in the fifth month an edict said, "The ancients said that when the roof leaks above, the knowledge is below.

sentences.zh: 朕所鐘過，不能自覺。

translations.literal: My accumulated faults—I cannot perceive them myself.
translations.idiomatic: The faults I have piled up, I cannot see for myself.

sentences.zh: 江子四等封事如上，尚書可時加檢括，於民有蠹患者，便卽勒停，宜速詳啓，勿致淹緩。

translations.literal: The sealed memorial of Jiang Zisi and others as above—the Masters of Writing shall promptly examine; whatever harms the people—stop it at once; report in detail quickly, without delay."
translations.idiomatic: The sealed memorial of Jiang Zisi and the others, as above, is to be examined at once by the Masters of Writing; whatever harms the people is to be stopped immediately and reported in detail without delay."

sentences.zh: 」乙巳，以魏前梁州刺史元羅爲征北大將軍、青、冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: On day yisi, former Wei Liangzhou inspector Yuan Luo was made General Who Conquers the North and Qing and Ji inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day former Wei Liangzhou inspector Yuan Luo was made General Who Conquers the North and inspector of Qing and Ji.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥，詔曰：「南郊、明堂、陵廟等令，與朝請同班，於事爲輕，可改視散騎侍郎。」

translations.literal: In the sixth month, day dinghai, an edict said: "Directors of the Southern Suburb, Bright Hall, tombs, and temples share rank with Gentlemen-Attendance—too light for their duties; they may be treated as Regular Attendant Cavalier."
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day in the sixth month an edict said, "The directors of the Southern Suburb, Bright Hall, tombs, and temples share rank with Gentlemen-Attendance, which is too slight for their charge; they may be treated as Regular Attendant Cavalier."

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙亥，詔大舉北伐。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, day yihai, an edict ordered a major northern expedition.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day in the tenth month of winter an edict ordered a great northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥，詔北伐衆班師。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, day jihai, an edict ordered the northern expedition army to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day in the eleventh month an edict ordered the northern expedition force to return.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，京師地震。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the capital shook with an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，魏請通和，詔許之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, day renshen, Wei requested peace; an edict granted it.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day in the twelfth month Wei asked for peace, and an edict granted it.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以吳興太守、駙馬都尉、利亭侯張纘爲吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Wu Xing commandery governor, Commandant of Cavalry Escort, Marquis of Liting Zhang Zuan was made Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Zhang Zuan, governor of Wu Xing, Commandant of Cavalry Escort, and Marquis of Liting, was made Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月辛丑，輿駕親祠南郊，大赦天下；

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, day xinchou, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburb, and a general amnesty was granted for the empire;
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day in the first month of spring, year 3, the emperor sacrificed at the Southern Suburb in person and proclaimed a general amnesty;

sentences.zh: 孝悌力田賜爵一級。

translations.literal: filial and diligent farmers were granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: filial and diligent farmers received one rank of nobility.

sentences.zh: 是夜，朱雀門災。

translations.literal: That night the Vermilion Bird Gate burned.
translations.idiomatic: That night the Vermilion Bird Gate was destroyed by fire.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，天無雲，雨灰，黃色。

translations.literal: On day renyin, though the sky was cloudless, ash rained down, yellow in color.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the sky was clear, yet yellow ash fell like rain.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以中書令卲陵王綸爲江州刺史。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Secretariat Director Prince of Shaoling Lun was made Jiangzhou inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Secretariat Director Prince of Shaoling Lun was made inspector of Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月乙酉，老人星見。

translations.literal: In the second month, day yiyou, the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day in the second month the Old Man star appeared.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，輿駕親耕籍田。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the imperial carriage personally plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the emperor plowed the sacred field in person.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以尚書左僕射何敬容爲中權將軍，護軍將軍蕭淵藻爲安右將軍、尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing He Jingrong was made Central Authority General; Guard Army General Xiao Yuanzao was made Right Pacification General and Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing He Jingrong was made Central Authority General, and Guard Army General Xiao Yuanzao was made Right Pacification General and Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 以尚書右僕射謝舉爲右光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Xie Ju was made Right Grand Master of Brilliant Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Xie Ju was made Right Grand Master of Brilliant Happiness.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以安南將軍廬陵王續爲中衛將軍、護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, General Who Pacifies the South, Prince of Luling Xu, was made Central Guard General and Guard Army General.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day General Who Pacifies the South, Prince of Luling Xu, was made Central Guard General and Guard Army General.

sentences.zh: 三月戊戌，立昭明太子子𧫷爲武昌郡王，譼爲義陽郡王。

translations.literal: In the third month, day wuxu, Crown Prince Zhaoming's son Zi was made Prince of Wuchang, and Tan was made Prince of Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day in the third month Crown Prince Zhaoming's son Zi was enfeoffed as Prince of Wuchang, and Tan as Prince of Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁卯，以南琅邪、彭城二郡太守河東王譽爲南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, day dingmao, Prince of Hedong Yu, governor of Southern Langye and Pengcheng commanderies, was made South Xuzhou inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day in the fourth month of summer Prince of Hedong Yu, governor of Southern Langye and Pengcheng, was made inspector of South Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月丙申，以前揚州刺史武陵王紀復爲揚州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, day bingshen, former Yangzhou inspector Prince of Wuling Ji was restored as Yangzhou inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day in the fifth month former Yangzhou inspector Prince of Wuling Ji was restored to Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月，青州朐山境隕霜。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, frost fell in the Qushan borderlands of Qing province.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month frost fell in the Qushan region of Qing province.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸卯，魏遣使來聘。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, day guimao, Wei sent envoys on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day in the seventh month of autumn Wei sent envoys on a friendly visit.

sentences.zh: 己酉，義陽王譼薨。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Prince of Yiyang Tan died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Prince of Yiyang Tan died.

sentences.zh: 是月，青州雪，害苗稼。

translations.literal: That month snow fell in Qing province and harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: That month Qing province saw snow that damaged the grain.

sentences.zh: 八月甲申，老人星見。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day jiashen, the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day in the eighth month the Old Man star appeared.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，輿駕幸阿育王寺，赦天下。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the imperial carriage visited King Asoka Temple and granted amnesty for the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the emperor visited King Asoka Temple and proclaimed amnesty for the empire.

sentences.zh: 九月，南兗州大饑。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, South Yanzhou suffered great famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month South Yanzhou fell into severe famine.

sentences.zh: 是月，北徐州境內旅生稻稗二千許頃。

translations.literal: That month wild rice and barnyard grass grew spontaneously across some two thousand qing within Northern Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month wild rice and barnyard grass sprang up across some two thousand qing in Northern Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲子，安西將軍、荊州刺史湘東王繹進號鎮西將軍，揚州刺史武陵王紀爲安西將軍、益州刺史。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, day jiazi, General Who Secures the West, Jingzhou inspector Prince Yi of Xiangdong was promoted to General Who Guards the West; Yangzhou inspector Prince of Wuling Ji was made General Who Secures the West and Yizhou inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day in the intercalary month General Who Secures the West, Prince Yi of Xiangdong, inspector of Jingzhou, was promoted to General Who Guards the West, and Yangzhou inspector Prince of Wuling Ji was made General Who Secures the West and inspector of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙辰，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, day bingchen, the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day in the tenth month of winter the capital shook with an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 是歲，饑。

translations.literal: That year famine spread.
translations.idiomatic: That year the land knew famine.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月庚辰，以中軍將軍宣城王大器爲中軍大將軍、揚州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, day gengchen, Central Army General Prince of Xuancheng Daqi was made Central Army Grand General and Yangzhou inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day in the first month of spring, year 4, Central Army General Prince of Xuancheng Daqi was made Central Army Grand General and inspector of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，輿駕親耕籍田。

translations.literal: In the second month, day jihai, the imperial carriage personally plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day in the second month the emperor plowed the sacred field in person.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅，河南國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the third month, day wuyin, the Henan kingdom sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day in the third month the Henan kingdom sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸未，芮芮國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Rouran sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Rouran sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月甲戌，魏遣使來聘。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, day jiaxu, Wei sent envoys on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day in the fifth month Wei sent envoys on a friendly visit.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未，以南琅邪、彭城二郡太守岳陽王詧爲東揚州刺史。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, day jiwei, Prince of Yueyang Cha, governor of Southern Langye and Pengcheng commanderies, was made East Yangzhou inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day in the seventh month of autumn Prince of Yueyang Cha, governor of Southern Langye and Pengcheng, was made inspector of East Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔以東冶徒李胤之降如來真形舍利，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On day guihai, an edict proclaimed general amnesty on account of Li Yin, a convict of the Eastern Smelterworks, who had surrendered a true-form relic of the Tathagata.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day an edict granted general amnesty because Li Yin, a convict of the Eastern Smelterworks, had surrendered a true-form relic of the Tathagata.

sentences.zh: 八月甲辰，詔「南兗、北徐、西徐、東徐、青、冀、南北青、武、仁、潼、睢等十二州，旣經饑饉，曲赦逋租宿責，勿收今年三調。」

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day jiachen, an edict said: "The twelve provinces—South Yanzhou, North Xuzhou, West Xuzhou, East Xuzhou, Qing, Ji, North and South Qing, Wu, Ren, Tong, and Sui—having suffered famine, shall receive partial amnesty of overdue rents and old debts; do not collect this year's three levies."
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day in the eighth month an edict said, "The twelve provinces—South Yanzhou, North Xuzhou, West Xuzhou, East Xuzhou, Qing, Ji, North and South Qing, Wu, Ren, Tong, and Sui—having endured famine, are granted partial amnesty of overdue rents and old debts; this year's three levies are not to be collected."

sentences.zh: 冬十二月丁亥，兼國子助教皇侃表上所撰《禮記義疏》五十卷。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, day dinghai, Adjunct National University Tutor Huang Kan submitted his fifty-volume Exegesis of the Record of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day in the twelfth month of winter Adjunct National University Tutor Huang Kan submitted his fifty-volume Exegesis of the Record of Rites.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月乙卯，以護軍將軍廬陵王續爲驃騎將軍、開府儀同三司，安右將軍、尚書左僕射蕭淵藻爲中衛將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, day yimao, Guard Army General Prince of Luling Xu was made Flying Cavalry General with open office and third-rank ceremonial parity; Right Pacification General and Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Xiao Yuanzao was made Central Guard General with open office and third-rank ceremonial parity.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day in the first month of spring, year 5, Guard Army General Prince of Luling Xu was made Flying Cavalry General with an open office and third-rank ceremonial parity, and Right Pacification General Xiao Yuanzao, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Central Guard General with an open office and third-rank ceremonial parity.

sentences.zh: 中權將軍、丹陽尹何敬容以本號爲尚書令，吏部尚書張纘爲尚書僕射，都官尚書劉孺爲吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Central Authority General and Danyang governor He Jingrong was made Director of the Masters of Writing under his former title; Minister of Personnel Zhang Zuan became Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Minister of Justice Liu Ru became Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Central Authority General He Jingrong, governor of Danyang, was made Director of the Masters of Writing under his former title; Minister of Personnel Zhang Zuan became Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; and Minister of Justice Liu Ru became Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，御史中丞、參禮儀事賀琛奏：「今南北二郊及籍田往還並宜禦輦，不復乘輅。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Censor-in-Chief He Chen, participating in ritual affairs, memorialized: "For the southern and northern suburban rites and the going and coming of the sacred-field plowing, the imperial carriage should be used; the ceremonial chariot should no longer be used.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Censor-in-Chief He Chen, who shared charge of ritual affairs, memorialized, "For the southern and northern suburban rites and the going and coming of the sacred-field plowing, the imperial carriage should be used, and the ceremonial chariot should no longer be used.

sentences.zh: 二郊請用素輦，籍田往還乘常輦，皆以侍中陪乘，停大將軍及太僕。

translations.literal: For both suburban rites use the plain carriage; for the sacred field use the regular carriage going and coming; in both cases let an attendant-in-ordinary ride as companion; suspend the grand general and grand marshal of stud posts."
translations.idiomatic: For both suburban rites use the plain carriage; for the sacred field use the regular carriage both ways; in both cases let an attendant-in-ordinary ride as companion; and suspend the grand general and grand marshal of stud posts."

sentences.zh: 」詔付尚書博議施行。

translations.literal: An edict referred the matter to the Masters of Writing for broad deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent the matter to the Masters of Writing for broad deliberation and implementation.

sentences.zh: 改素輦名大同輦。

translations.literal: The plain carriage was renamed the Datong Carriage.
translations.idiomatic: The plain carriage was given the name Datong Carriage.

sentences.zh: 昭祀宗廟乘玉輦。

translations.literal: For bright hall ancestral rites the jade carriage was used.
translations.idiomatic: For bright hall ancestral rites the jade carriage was to be used.

sentences.zh: 辛未，輿駕親祠南郊，詔孝悌力田及州閭鄉党稱爲善人者，各賜爵一級，並勒屬所以時騰上。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburb; an edict granted one rank of nobility to filial and diligent farmers and to those called good men in provinces, districts, and village groups, and ordered local offices to report them promptly.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the emperor sacrificed at the Southern Suburb in person; an edict granted one rank of nobility to filial and diligent farmers and to those called good men in provinces, districts, and village groups, and ordered local offices to report them without delay.

sentences.zh: 三月己未，詔曰：「朕四聽旣闕，五識多蔽，畫可外牒，或致紕繆。

translations.literal: In the third month, day jiwei, an edict said: "My four listeners are lacking, my five perceptions often obscured; approved memorials go out and errors may occur.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day in the third month an edict said, "My four listeners are lacking and my five perceptions often clouded; approved memorials go out from court and mistakes may follow.

sentences.zh: 凡是政事不便於民者，州郡縣卽時皆言，勿得欺隱。

translations.literal: All policy inconvenient to the people—province, commandery, and county must speak at once; no concealment.
translations.idiomatic: Whatever policy harms the people, province, commandery, and county must speak at once; nothing may be hidden.

sentences.zh: 如使怨訟，當境任失。

translations.literal: If grievances arise, local officials bear the blame.
translations.idiomatic: If grievances arise, the officials of that region bear the fault.

sentences.zh: 而今而後，以爲永准。」

translations.literal: From now on, this is the permanent standard."
translations.idiomatic: From this day forward, let this be the lasting rule."

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, day jimao, Flying Cavalry General Prince of Luling Xu, with open office and third-rank ceremonial parity, was made Jingzhou inspector; Prince Yi of Xiangdong was made Guard Army General and Right Pacification General.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day in the seventh month of autumn Flying Cavalry General Prince of Luling Xu, with an open office and third-rank ceremonial parity, was made inspector of Jingzhou, and Prince Yi of Xiangdong was made Guard Army General and Right Pacification General.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，扶南國遣使獻生犀及方物。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day yiyou, Funan sent envoys bearing live rhinoceros and tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day in the eighth month Funan sent envoys with a live rhinoceros and other tribute.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申，以都官尚書到溉爲吏部尚書。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day gengshen, Director of the Court of Judicature Dao Gai was made Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day in the ninth month, Director of the Court of Judicature Dao Gai was made Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月乙亥，魏遣使來聘。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, day yihai, Wei sent envoys on a friendly visit.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day in the eleventh month of winter, Wei sent envoys on a friendly visit.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸未，以吳郡太守謝舉爲中書監，新除中書令鄱陽王範爲中領軍。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, day guiwei, Wu commandery grand administrator Xie Ju was made Supervisor of the Palace Secretariat; the newly appointed Palace Secretariat Director Prince of Poyang Fan was made Central Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day in the twelfth month, Wu commandery grand administrator Xie Ju was made Supervisor of the Palace Secretariat, and the newly appointed Palace Secretariat Director Prince of Poyang Fan was made Central Guard General.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月庚戌朔，曲赦司、豫、徐、兗四州。

translations.literal: In year 6, spring, first month, gengxu new moon, a partial amnesty was granted for Si, Yu, Xu, and Yan provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu new moon of the first month in spring, year 6, Si, Yu, Xu, and Yan provinces received a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，輿駕親耕籍田。

translations.literal: In the second month, day jihai, the imperial carriage personally plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day in the second month the emperor plowed the sacred field in person.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以江州刺史卲陵王綸爲平西將軍、郢州刺史，雲麾將軍豫章王歡爲江州刺史。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Prince of Shaoling Lun, Jiangzhou inspector, was made General Who Pacifies the West and Yingzhou inspector; Cloud-Banner General Prince of Yuzhang Huan was made Jiangzhou inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Prince of Shaoling Lun, inspector of Jiangzhou, became General Who Pacifies the West and inspector of Yingzhou, and Cloud-Banner General Prince of Yuzhang Huan became inspector of Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 秦郡獻白鹿一。

translations.literal: Qin commandery presented one white deer.
translations.idiomatic: Qin commandery presented a white deer.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸未，詔曰：「命世興王，嗣賢傳業，聲稱不朽，人代徂遷，二賓以位，三恪義在，時事浸遠，宿草榛蕪，望古興懷，言念愴然。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, day guiwei, an edict said: "Fated rulers who rise in their age inherit the worthy and pass down their enterprise; their fame does not perish, yet generations pass away. The two guest houses receive rank, the three respectful houses stand by obligation; as time recedes, old graves grow over with weeds, and gazing back at antiquity fills the heart with sorrow.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day in the fourth month of summer an edict said, "Fated kings inherit the worthy and pass down their work; fame endures, yet generations turn. The two guest houses receive rank, the three respectful houses stand by obligation; as time recedes, old tombs grow over with weeds, and looking back at antiquity fills the heart with sorrow.

sentences.zh: 晉、宋、齊三代諸陵，有職司者勤加守護，勿令細民妄相侵毀。

translations.literal: The tombs of the Jin, Song, and Qi dynasties—wherever officials are assigned, let them diligently guard against wanton damage by common people.
translations.idiomatic: The tombs of Jin, Song, and Qi—wherever officials are assigned, let them guard diligently and not allow common people to damage them at will.

sentences.zh: 作兵有少，補使充足。

translations.literal: Where guard troops are too few, send reinforcements to fill the ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Where there are too few guard troops, send reinforcements to fill the ranks.

sentences.zh: 前無守視，並可量給。」

translations.literal: Where there were no watchers before, allot them in due measure."
translations.idiomatic: Where there were no watchers before, allot them in due measure."

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，以前青、冀二州刺史元羅爲右光祿大夫。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, day wuyin, former Qing and Ji province inspector Yuan Luo was made Right Grand Master of Brilliant Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day in the fifth month, former Qing and Ji province inspector Yuan Luo was made Right Grand Master of Brilliant Happiness.

sentences.zh: 己卯，河南王遣使獻馬及方物。

translations.literal: On jimao, the King of Henan sent envoys presenting horses and local products.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day the King of Henan sent envoys with horses and local products.

sentences.zh: 六月丁未，平陽縣獻白鹿一。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, day dingwei, Pingyang county presented one white deer.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day in the sixth month, Pingyang county presented a white deer.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁亥，魏遣使來聘。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, day dinghai, Wei sent envoys on a friendly visit.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day in the seventh month of autumn, Wei sent envoys on a friendly visit.

sentences.zh: 八月戊午，赦天下。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day wuwu, a general amnesty was granted for the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day in the eighth month the empire received a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔曰：「經國有體，必詢諸朝，所以尚書置令、僕、丞、郎，旦旦上朝，以議時事，前共籌懷，然後奏聞。

translations.literal: On xinwei, an edict said: "To govern a state there is a proper form, and one must consult the court; hence the Masters of Writing have director, vice-director, aide, and clerk, who attend court each morning to deliberate affairs of the day, consider them together, and then report upward.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day an edict said, "Governing a state has its proper form, and one must consult the court; hence the Masters of Writing have director, vice-director, aide, and clerk, who attend court each morning to deliberate the day's affairs, consider them together, and then report upward.

sentences.zh: 頃者不爾，每有疑事，倚立求決。

translations.literal: Lately this has not been so; whenever a doubtful matter arises, officials merely stand waiting for a decision.
translations.idiomatic: Lately this has not been so; whenever a doubtful matter arises, officials merely stand waiting for a decision.

sentences.zh: 古人有云，主非堯舜，何得發言便是。

translations.literal: The ancients said that unless the ruler is Yao or Shun, how can every utterance be treated as infallible?
translations.idiomatic: The ancients said that unless the ruler is Yao or Shun, how can every utterance be treated as infallible?

sentences.zh: 是故放勛之聖，猶咨四岳，重華之叡，亦待多士。

translations.literal: Thus even the sage Emperor Yao consulted the Four Peaks, and the wise Emperor Shun relied on many advisors.
translations.idiomatic: Thus even the sage Emperor Yao consulted the Four Peaks, and the wise Emperor Shun relied on many advisors.

sentences.zh: 豈朕寡德，所能獨斷。

translations.literal: How could someone of my limited virtue presume to decide alone?
translations.idiomatic: How could someone of my limited virtue decide alone?

sentences.zh: 自今尚書中有疑事，前於朝堂參議，然後啓聞，不得習常。

translations.literal: From now on, whenever the Masters of Writing encounter doubtful matters, they must first deliberate in the court hall and then report upward—this must not become mere routine.
translations.idiomatic: From now on, whenever the Masters of Writing encounter doubtful matters, they must first deliberate in the court hall and then report upward—this must not become mere routine.

sentences.zh: 其軍機要切，前須諮審，自依舊典。

translations.literal: Urgent military matters requiring prior consultation will follow established precedent."
translations.idiomatic: Urgent military matters requiring prior consultation will follow established precedent."

sentences.zh: 」盤盤國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Panpan sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Panpan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 九月，移安州置定遠郡，受北徐州都督，定遠郡改屬安州。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, An province was moved to Dingyuan commandery under Northern Xu province's supervision, and Dingyuan commandery was reassigned to An province.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month An province was moved to Dingyuan commandery under Northern Xu province's supervision, and Dingyuan commandery was reassigned to An province.

sentences.zh: 始平太守崔碩表獻嘉禾一莖十二穗。

translations.literal: Shi Commandery grand administrator Cui Shuo reported one stalk of auspicious grain with twelve ears.
translations.idiomatic: Shi commandery grand administrator Cui Shuo reported a stalk of auspicious grain with twelve ears.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，特進、左光祿大夫、司空袁昂薨。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Special Advancement, Left Grand Master of Brilliant Happiness, and Minister of Works Yuan Ang died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Special Advancement Yuan Ang, Left Grand Master of Brilliant Happiness and Minister of Works, died.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月己卯，曲赦京邑。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, day jimao, the capital received a partial amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day in the eleventh month of winter the capital received a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬子，江州刺史豫章王歡薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, day renzi, Prince of Yuzhang Huan, Jiangzhou inspector, died.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day in the twelfth month Prince of Yuzhang Huan, inspector of Jiangzhou, died.

sentences.zh: 以護軍將軍湘東王繹爲鎮南將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: General Who Protects the Army Prince of Xiangdong Yi was made General Who Guards the South and Jiangzhou inspector.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Protects the Army Prince of Xiangdong Yi was made General Who Guards the South and inspector of Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 置桂州於湘州始安郡，受湘州督；

translations.literal: Gui province was established at Shi'an in Xiang province under Xiang province's supervision;
translations.idiomatic: Gui province was established at Shi'an in Xiang province under Xiang province's supervision;

sentences.zh: 省南桂林等二十四郡，悉改屬桂州。

translations.literal: twenty-four southern Guilin commanderies were abolished and all reassigned to Gui province.
translations.idiomatic: twenty-four southern Guilin commanderies were abolished and all reassigned to Gui province.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月辛巳，輿駕親祠南郊，赦天下，其有流移及失桑梓者，各還田宅，蠲課五年。

translations.literal: In year 7, spring, first month, day xinsi, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburb; a general amnesty was granted for the empire; those displaced or who had lost their ancestral lands were each permitted to return to their fields and homes, with taxes remitted for five years.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day in the first month of spring, year 7, the emperor sacrificed at the Southern Suburb in person, proclaimed a general amnesty, and allowed the displaced and those who had lost ancestral lands to return to their fields and homes with five years of tax remission.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，輿駕親祠明堂。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day the emperor sacrificed at the Bright Hall in person.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，以行宕昌王梁彌泰爲平西將軍、河涼二州刺史、宕昌王。

translations.literal: In the second month, day yisi, Acting King of Dangchang Liang Mitai was made General Who Pacifies the West, inspector of He and Liang provinces, and King of Dangchang.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day in the second month Acting King of Dangchang Liang Mitai was made General Who Pacifies the West, inspector of He and Liang provinces, and King of Dangchang.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，輿駕躬耕籍田。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the imperial carriage personally plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the emperor plowed the sacred field in person.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，京師地震。

translations.literal: On yimao, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以中領軍、鄱陽王範爲鎮北將軍、雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Central Guard General Prince of Poyang Fan was made General Who Guards the North and Yong province inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Central Guard General Prince of Poyang Fan was made General Who Guards the North and inspector of Yong province.

sentences.zh: 三月乙亥，宕昌王遣使獻馬及方物。

translations.literal: In the third month, day yihai, the King of Dangchang sent envoys presenting horses and local products.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day in the third month the King of Dangchang sent envoys with horses and local products.

sentences.zh: 高麗、百濟、滑國各遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Goguryeo, Baekje, and Huaguo each sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Goguryeo, Baekje, and Huaguo each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申，魏遣使來聘。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, day wushen, Wei sent envoys on a friendly visit.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day in the fourth month of summer, Wei sent envoys on a friendly visit.

sentences.zh: 五月癸己，以侍中南康王會理兼領軍。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, day guisi, Palace Attendant Prince of Nankang Huili was made concurrent commander of the guard.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day in the fifth month Palace Attendant Prince of Nankang Huili was made concurrent commander of the guard.

sentences.zh: 秋九月戊寅，芮芮國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of autumn, day wuyin, Rouran sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day in the ninth month of autumn Rouran sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，以侍中劉孺爲吏部尚書。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, day bingwu, Palace Attendant Liu Ru was made Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day in the tenth month of winter Palace Attendant Liu Ru was made Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，詔停在所役使女丁。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, day bingzi, an edict halted the conscription of women for corvée labor wherever they were employed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day in the eleventh month an edict halted the conscription of women for corvée labor wherever they were employed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔曰：「民之多幸，國之不幸，恩澤屢加，彌長姦盜，朕亦知此之爲病矣。

translations.literal: On dingchou, an edict said: "When the people are too fortunate, the state suffers misfortune; repeated acts of grace only prolong theft and fraud—I know this is a sickness.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict said, "When the people are too fortunate, the state suffers misfortune; repeated acts of grace only prolong theft and fraud—I know this is a sickness.

sentences.zh: 如不優赦，非仁人之心。

translations.literal: Yet if I do not grant further amnesty, that is not the heart of a benevolent man.
translations.idiomatic: Yet if I do not grant further amnesty, that is not the heart of a benevolent man.

sentences.zh: 凡厥諐耗逋負，起今七年十一月九日昧爽以前，在民間無問多少，言上尚書，督所未入者，皆赦除之。

translations.literal: All unpaid taxes and deficits owed before dawn on the ninth day of the eleventh month of year 7—whatever amount among the people—when reported to the Masters of Writing, and whatever remains uncollected by the supervising offices, shall all be forgiven and remitted.
translations.idiomatic: All unpaid taxes and deficits owed before dawn on the ninth day of the eleventh month of year 7—whatever amount among the people—when reported to the Masters of Writing, and whatever remains uncollected by the supervising offices, shall all be forgiven and remitted.

sentences.zh: 」又詔曰：「用天之道，分地之利，蓋先聖之格訓也。

translations.literal: " Another edict said: "To use Heaven's way and divide Earth's benefits—this is the instruction of the ancient sages.
translations.idiomatic: " Another edict said, "To use Heaven's way and divide Earth's benefit—this is the instruction of the ancient sages.

sentences.zh: 凡是田桑廢宅沒入者，公創之外，悉以分給貧民，皆使量其所能以受田分。

translations.literal: All abandoned fields and homesteads seized by the state, beyond what the government itself develops, shall all be distributed to the poor, each receiving land in measure of his capacity.
translations.idiomatic: All abandoned fields and homesteads seized by the state, beyond what the government itself develops, shall all be distributed to the poor, each receiving land in measure of his capacity.

sentences.zh: 如聞頃者，豪家富室，多占取公田，貴價僦稅，以與貧民，傷時害政，爲蠹已甚。

translations.literal: I have heard that lately powerful houses and wealthy families have widely seized public fields, renting them at high rates to the poor—a practice that harms the times and damages governance, a pestilence beyond measure.
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that lately powerful houses and wealthy families have widely seized public fields, renting them at high rates to the poor—a practice that harms the times and damages governance, a pestilence beyond measure.

sentences.zh: 自今公田悉不得假與豪家；

translations.literal: From now on public fields may in no case be leased to powerful families;
translations.idiomatic: From now on public fields may in no case be leased to powerful families;

sentences.zh: 已假者特聽不追。

translations.literal: those already leased are specially permitted not to be pursued for recovery.
translations.idiomatic: those already leased are specially permitted not to be pursued for recovery.

sentences.zh: 其若富室給貧民種糧共營作者，不在禁例。

translations.literal: Where wealthy households supply seed and grain to share cultivation with the poor, that is not within the prohibition."
translations.idiomatic: Where wealthy households supply seed and grain to share cultivation with the poor, that is not within the prohibition."

sentences.zh: 」己丑，以金紫光祿大夫臧盾爲領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On jichou, Grand Master for Golden Seal and Purple Sash Zang Dun was made Commander of the Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Grand Master for Golden Seal and Purple Sash Zang Dun was made Commander of the Guard.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅，詔曰：「古人云，一物失所，如納諸隍，未是切言也。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, day renyin, an edict said: "The ancients said that to lose even one thing is like falling into a moat—hardly an exaggeration.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day in the twelfth month an edict said, "The ancients said that to lose even one thing is like falling into a moat—hardly an exaggeration.

sentences.zh: 朕寒心消志，爲日久矣，每當食投箸，方眠徹枕，獨坐懷憂，憤慨申旦，非爲一人，萬姓故耳。

translations.literal: I have long chilled my heart and emptied my resolve; at meals I set down my chopsticks, at sleep I rise from my pillow, sitting alone in worry, indignant until dawn—not for one man alone, but for the myriad people.
translations.idiomatic: I have long chilled my heart and emptied my resolve; at meals I set down my chopsticks, at sleep I rise from my pillow, sitting alone in worry, indignant until dawn—not for one man alone, but for the myriad people.

sentences.zh: 州牧多非良才，守宰虎而傅翼，楊阜是故憂憤，賈誼所以流涕。

translations.literal: Provincial governors are often not men of talent; local magistrates are tigers given wings—Yang Fu was thus aggrieved, Jia Yi thus moved to tears.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial governors are often not men of talent; local magistrates are tigers given wings—Yang Fu was thus aggrieved, Jia Yi thus moved to tears.

sentences.zh: 至於民間誅求萬端，或供廚帳，或供廄庫，或遣使命，或待賓客，皆無自費，取給於民。

translations.literal: Among the people exactions multiply endlessly: some supply kitchen expenses, some stable and treasury costs, some entertain envoys, some host guests—all without personal expense, drawing everything from the populace.
translations.idiomatic: Among the people exactions multiply endlessly: some supply kitchen expenses, some stable and treasury costs, some entertain envoys, some host guests—all without personal expense, drawing everything from the populace.

sentences.zh: 又復多遣遊軍，稱爲遏防，姦盜不止，暴掠繁多，或求供設，或責腳步。

translations.literal: Patrol forces are also widely dispatched under the pretext of blocking bandits, yet theft continues and violent plunder increases—demanding provisions, demanding porter fees.
translations.idiomatic: Patrol forces are also widely dispatched under the pretext of blocking bandits, yet theft continues and violent plunder increases—demanding provisions, demanding porter fees.

sentences.zh: 又行劫縱，更相枉逼，良人命盡，富室財殫。

translations.literal: They also permit robbery among themselves, mutually extorting until common people's lives are exhausted and wealthy households ruined.
translations.idiomatic: They also permit robbery among themselves, mutually extorting until common people's lives are exhausted and wealthy households ruined.

sentences.zh: 此爲怨酷，非止一事。

translations.literal: This breeds resentment and cruelty—not in one matter alone.
translations.idiomatic: This breeds resentment and cruelty—not in one matter alone.

sentences.zh: 亦頻禁斷，猶自未已，外司明加聽采，隨事舉奏。

translations.literal: Though repeatedly forbidden, it persists; outer offices must investigate openly and report each case as it arises.
translations.idiomatic: Though repeatedly forbidden, it persists; outer offices must investigate openly and report each case as it arises.

sentences.zh: 又復公私傳、屯、邸、冶，爰至僧尼，當其地界，止應依限守視；

translations.literal: Furthermore, private relay stations, military colonies, hostel inns, and ironworks—even monasteries and nunneries—within their boundaries should only guard according to limits;
translations.idiomatic: Furthermore, private relay stations, military colonies, hostel inns, and ironworks—even monasteries and nunneries—within their boundaries should only guard according to limits;

sentences.zh: 乃至廣加封固，越界分斷水陸採捕及以樵蘇，遂致細民措手無所。

translations.literal: yet many overextend their enclosures, dividing waterways and land to block fishing and firewood gathering, leaving common people nowhere to turn.
translations.idiomatic: yet many overextend their enclosures, dividing waterways and land to block fishing and firewood gathering, leaving common people nowhere to turn.

sentences.zh: 凡自今有越界禁斷者，禁斷之身，皆以軍法從事。

translations.literal: From now on, whoever oversteps boundaries in blocking access shall himself be punished by military law.
translations.idiomatic: From now on, whoever oversteps boundaries in blocking access shall himself be punished by military law.

sentences.zh: 若是公家創內，止不得輒自立屯，與公競作以收私利。

translations.literal: On government-developed lands within the public domain, none may arbitrarily establish private colonies competing with the state for profit.
translations.idiomatic: On government-developed lands within the public domain, none may arbitrarily establish private colonies competing with the state for profit.

sentences.zh: 至百姓樵采以供煙爨者，悉不得禁。

translations.literal: Gathering firewood for cooking must not be forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Gathering firewood for cooking must not be forbidden.

sentences.zh: 及以採捕，亦勿訶問。

translations.literal: Fishing and hunting likewise must not be interrogated.
translations.idiomatic: Fishing and hunting likewise must not be interrogated.

sentences.zh: 若不遵承，皆以死罪結正。

translations.literal: Whoever does not comply shall be punished by death."
translations.idiomatic: Whoever does not comply shall be punished by death."

sentences.zh: 」魏遣使來聘。

translations.literal: Wei sent envoys on a friendly visit.
translations.idiomatic: Wei sent envoys on a friendly visit.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，於宮城西立士林館，延集學者。

translations.literal: On bingchen, the Scholar Grove Hall was established west of the palace to gather scholars.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the Scholar Grove Hall was established west of the palace to gather scholars.

sentences.zh: 是歲，交州土民李賁攻刺史蕭諮，諮輸賂，得還越州。

translations.literal: That year, Jiao province native Li Bin attacked Inspector Xiao Zi; Zi paid bribes and fled back to Yue province.
translations.idiomatic: That year Jiao province native Li Bin attacked Inspector Xiao Zi; Zi paid bribes and fled back to Yue province.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月，安成郡民劉敬躬挾左道以反，內史蕭說委郡東奔，敬躬據郡，進攻廬陵，取豫章，妖黨遂至數萬，前逼新淦、柴桑。

translations.literal: In spring of year 8, first month, Liu Jinggong of Ancheng commandery, wielding heterodox arts, rebelled; Administrator Xiao Shuo abandoned the commandery and fled east; Jinggong seized the commandery, attacked Luling, took Yuzhang, and his demonic faction swelled to tens of thousands, pressing toward Xingan and Chaisang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring, year 8, Liu Jinggong of Ancheng commandery, wielding heterodox arts, rebelled; Administrator Xiao Shuo abandoned the commandery and fled east; Jinggong seized the commandery, attacked Luling, took Yuzhang, and his demonic faction swelled to tens of thousands, pressing toward Xingan and Chaisang.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌，江州刺史湘東王繹遣中兵曹子郢討之。

translations.literal: In the second month, day wuxu, Prince of Xiangdong Yi, Jiangzhou inspector, sent Central Army Cao Ziye to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day in the second month Prince of Xiangdong Yi, inspector of Jiangzhou, sent Central Army Cao Ziye to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰，大破之，擒敬躬送京師，斬于建康市。

translations.literal: In the third month, day wuchen, he thoroughly defeated them; Jinggong was captured and sent to the capital, beheaded at Jiankang market.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day in the third month he thoroughly defeated them; Jinggong was captured and sent to the capital and beheaded at Jiankang market.

sentences.zh: 是月，于江州新蔡、高塘立頌平屯，墾作蠻田。

translations.literal: That month, Songping garrison was established at Xincai and Gaotang in Jiangzhou to reclaim barbarian lands.
translations.idiomatic: That month Songping garrison was established at Xincai and Gaotang in Jiangzhou to reclaim barbarian lands.

sentences.zh: 遣越州刺史陳侯、羅州刺史寧巨、安州刺史李智、愛州刺史阮漢，同征李賁於交州。

translations.literal: Yue province Inspector Chen Hou, Luo province Inspector Ning Ju, An province Inspector Li Zhi, and Ai province Inspector Ruan Han jointly marched against Li Bin in Jiao province.
translations.idiomatic: Yue province inspector Chen Hou, Luo province inspector Ning Ju, An province inspector Li Zhi, and Ai province inspector Ruan Han jointly marched against Li Bin in Jiao province.

sentences.zh: 九年春閏月丙申，地震，生毛。

translations.literal: In the intercalary first month of spring, year 9, day bingchen, an earthquake occurred and hair grew from the ground.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day in the intercalary first month of spring, year 9, an earthquake occurred and hair grew from the ground.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，使江州民三十家出奴婢一戶，配送司州。

translations.literal: In the second month, day jiaxu, thirty Jiangzhou households were required to furnish one slave household, sent to Si province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day in the second month, thirty Jiangzhou households were required to furnish one slave household, sent to Si province.

sentences.zh: 三月，以太子詹事謝舉爲尚書僕射。

translations.literal: In the third month, Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent Xie Ju was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent Xie Ju was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，林邑王破德州，攻李賁，賁將范脩又破林邑王於九德，林邑王敗走。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, the King of Linyi broke Dez prefecture and attacked Li Bin; Bin's general Fan Xiu then defeated the King of Linyi at Jiude, and the King of Linyi fled in defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer the King of Linyi broke Dez prefecture and attacked Li Bin; Bin's general Fan Xiu then defeated the King of Linyi at Jiude, and the King of Linyi fled in defeat.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月辛丑，安西將軍、益州刺史武陵王紀進號征西將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, day xinchou, General Who Pacifies the West Prince of Wuling Ji, Yi province inspector, was promoted to General Who Conquers the West with open office and ceremonial parity of the Three Dignities.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day in the eleventh month of winter General Who Pacifies the West Prince of Wuling Ji, inspector of Yi province, was promoted to General Who Conquers the West with an open office and ceremonial parity of the Three Dignities.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬戌，領軍將軍臧盾卒；

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, day renxu, Commander of the Guard Zang Dun died;
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day in the twelfth month Commander of the Guard Zang Dun died;

sentences.zh: 以輕車將軍河東王譽爲領軍將軍。

translations.literal: Light Chariots General Prince of Hedong Yu was made Commander of the Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Light Chariots General Prince of Hedong Yu was made Commander of the Guard.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月，李賁於交址竊位號，署置百官。

translations.literal: In spring of year 10, first month, Li Bin usurped title and office in Jiaozhi, appointing officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring, year 10, Li Bin usurped title and office in Jiaozhi, appointing officials.

sentences.zh: 三月甲午，輿駕幸蘭陵，謁建寧陵。

translations.literal: In the third month, day jiawu, the imperial carriage visited Lanling and paid respects at Jianning tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day in the third month the emperor visited Lanling and paid respects at Jianning tomb.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，至脩陵。

translations.literal: On xinchou, he reached Xiuling.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day he reached Xiuling.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔曰：「朕自違桑梓，五十餘載，乃眷東顧，靡日不思。

translations.literal: On renyin, an edict said: "I have been away from my homeland more than fifty years; ever turning my gaze eastward, not a day passes without longing.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day an edict said, "I have been away from my homeland more than fifty years; ever turning my gaze eastward, not a day passes without longing.

sentences.zh: 今四方款關，海外有截，獄訟稍簡，國務小閑，始獲展敬園陵，但增感慟。

translations.literal: Now the four quarters come in submission, the outer seas are bounded, lawsuits grow simpler, and state affairs are somewhat at ease—only now have I been able to pay reverence at the imperial tombs, yet my grief only deepens.
translations.idiomatic: Now the four quarters come in submission, the outer seas are bounded, lawsuits grow simpler, and state affairs are somewhat at ease—only now have I been able to pay reverence at the imperial tombs, yet my grief only deepens.

sentences.zh: 故鄉老少，接踵遠至，情貌孜孜，若歸于父，宜有以慰其此心。

translations.literal: Elders of my old home arrived in succession from afar, their faces eager as if returning to a father; I should have means to comfort their hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Elders of my old home arrived in succession from afar, their faces eager as if returning to a father; I should have means to comfort their hearts.

sentences.zh: 並可錫位一階，並加頒賚。

translations.literal: All are granted one rank of nobility and additional gifts.
translations.idiomatic: All are granted one rank of nobility and additional gifts.

sentences.zh: 所經縣邑，無出今年租賦。

translations.literal: The counties and districts passed through shall not levy this year's land tax.
translations.idiomatic: The counties and districts passed through shall not levy this year's land tax.

sentences.zh: 監所責民，蠲復二年。

translations.literal: Those indebted for corvée labor at the supervisory offices shall be remitted for two years.
translations.idiomatic: Those indebted for corvée labor at the supervisory offices shall be remitted for two years.

sentences.zh: 並普賚內外從官軍主左右錢米各有差。

translations.literal: All inner and outer attendants, army commanders, and personal attendants shall receive graded gifts of money and grain."
translations.idiomatic: All inner and outer attendants, army commanders, and personal attendants shall receive graded gifts of money and grain."

sentences.zh: 」因作《還舊鄉》詩。

translations.literal: Thereupon he composed the poem "Returning to the Old Homeland."
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he composed the poem "Returning to the Old Homeland."

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔園陵職司，恭事勤勞，並錫位一階，並加頒賚。

translations.literal: On guimao, an edict said: "The officials of the imperial tombs, reverent in service and diligent in labor, are all granted one rank of nobility and additional gifts."
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day an edict said, "The officials of the imperial tombs, reverent in service and diligent in labor, are all granted one rank of nobility and additional gifts."

sentences.zh: 丁未，仁威將軍、南徐州刺史臨川王正義進號安東將軍。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Benevolent Might General Prince of Linchuan Zhengyi, South Xu province inspector, was promoted to General Who Pacifies the East.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Benevolent Might General Prince of Linchuan Zhengyi, inspector of South Xu province, was promoted to General Who Pacifies the East.

sentences.zh: 己酉，幸京口城北固樓，改名北顧。

translations.literal: On jiyou, he visited Beigu Tower north of Jingkou city and renamed it North Gazing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day he visited Beigu Tower north of Jingkou city and renamed it North Gazing.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，幸回賓亭，宴帝鄉故老及所經近縣奉迎候者少長數千人，各賚錢二千。

translations.literal: On gengxu, he visited Huibin Pavilion and feasted the elders of the imperial homeland and the welcoming crowds from nearby counties, young and old numbering several thousand; each received two thousand coins.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day he visited Huibin Pavilion and feasted the elders of the imperial homeland and the welcoming crowds from nearby counties, young and old numbering several thousand; each received two thousand coins.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，輿駕至自蘭陵。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, day yimao, the imperial carriage returned from Lanling.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day in the fourth month of summer, the emperor returned from Lanling.

sentences.zh: 詔鰥寡孤獨尤貧者贍卹各有差。

translations.literal: An edict granted widowers, widows, orphans, and solitaries in deepest poverty graded relief and support.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered graded relief for widowers, widows, orphans, and the destitute alone.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉，尚書令何敬容免。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, day dingyou, Director of the Masters of Writing He Jingrong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day in the fifth month, He Jingrong was removed as Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 秋九月己丑，詔曰：「今茲遠近，雨澤調適，其獲已及，冀必萬箱，宜使百姓因斯安樂。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of autumn, day jichou, an edict said: "Near and far this year, rain and dew have been well timed, the harvest is in, and we hope for granaries full to the brim—let the people take ease and joy in this.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day in the ninth month of autumn an edict said, "Near and far, rain has come in season, the harvest is home, and we look for full granaries—let the people rest in this good fortune.

sentences.zh: 凡天下罪無輕重，已發覺未發覺，討捕未擒者，皆赦宥之。

translations.literal: All crimes under Heaven, heavy or light, whether discovered or not, whether sought but not yet captured—all are pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Every crime under Heaven, light or heavy, discovered or not, sought but not yet taken—all are pardoned.

sentences.zh: 侵割耗散官物，無問多少，亦悉原除。

translations.literal: Embezzlement, seizure, or dissipation of government goods, regardless of amount, is also fully remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Embezzlement or waste of government property, in any amount, is likewise forgiven.

sentences.zh: 田者荒廢、水旱不作、無當時文列，應追稅者，並作田不登公格者，並停。

translations.literal: Where fields lie fallow, drought or flood prevented harvest, no records exist from the time, taxes should be pursued, or harvest failed official standards—all are suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Fallow fields, drought and flood losses, missing records, back taxes, and failed harvests by official measure—all collections stop.

sentences.zh: 各備臺州以文最逋殿，罪悉從原。

translations.literal: All cases of ranked officials' arrears in provinces and inspectorates are fully pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Arrears owed by ranked officials in every province and inspectorate are fully forgiven.

sentences.zh: 其有因饑逐食，離鄉去土，悉聽復業，蠲課五年。」

translations.literal: Those who left land and home to follow food in famine may all return to their trades, with taxes remitted five years."
translations.idiomatic: Those who fled hunger and abandoned their land may all return to their trades, with five years' tax remission."

sentences.zh: 冬十二月，大雪，平地三尺。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, heavy snow fell—three feet on level ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter snow piled three feet deep on level ground.

sentences.zh: 十一年春三月庚辰，詔曰：「皇王在昔，澤風未遠，故端居玄扈，拱默岩廊。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, spring, third month, day gengchen, an edict said: "Ancient emperors and kings, when royal virtue had not yet faded, could dwell at ease in their inner halls and govern in silence from the cliff gallery.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day in the third month of the eleventh year an edict said, "In olden days, when royal virtue still ran deep, rulers could sit quietly in their inner halls and govern in silence from the cliff gallery.

sentences.zh: 自大道旣淪，澆波斯逝，動競日滋，情偽彌作。

translations.literal: Since the Great Way sank, a torrent of decay has flowed on; striving and rivalry grow daily, and false sentiment grows ever more rife.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Great Way fell, decay has rushed on; rivalry grows by the day, and false feeling ever more prevails.

sentences.zh: 朕負扆君臨，百年將半。

translations.literal: I have taken the throne with the screen at my back, and nearly half a century has passed.
translations.idiomatic: I have ruled with the screen at my back, and nearly half a century has gone by.

sentences.zh: 宵漏未分，躬勞政事；
