translations.literal: Before the night watch is divided I am already at work on government;
translations.idiomatic: Before the night watch ends I am already at work on affairs of state;

sentences.zh: 白日西浮，不遑飱飯。

translations.literal: when the sun sinks west I have not yet taken a meal.
translations.idiomatic: when the sun sinks west I have not yet eaten.

sentences.zh: 退居猶於布素，含咀匪過藜藿。

translations.literal: Even in retreat I dress in plain cloth and eat no more than wild greens.
translations.idiomatic: Even at rest I wear plain cloth and taste nothing finer than wild greens.

sentences.zh: 寧以萬乘爲貴，四海爲富；

translations.literal: I do not prize the chariots of ten thousand for wealth, nor the four seas for riches;
translations.idiomatic: I do not count the chariots of ten thousand as wealth, nor the four seas as riches;

sentences.zh: 唯欲億兆康寧，下民安乂。

translations.literal: I wish only that the hundred millions live in peace and the people below be secure.
translations.idiomatic: I wish only that the hundred millions know peace and the people below live in order.

sentences.zh: 雖復三思行事，而百慮多失。

translations.literal: Though I think thrice before acting, a hundred concerns still miss the mark.
translations.idiomatic: Though I think thrice before I act, a hundred plans still go wrong.

sentences.zh: 凡遠近分置、內外條流、四方所立屯、傳、邸、冶，市埭、桁渡，津稅、田園，新舊守宰，遊軍戍邏，有不便於民者，尚書州郡各速條上，當隨言除省，以舒民患。」

translations.literal: All distant and near appointments, inner and outer regulations, garrisons, courier posts, lodges, smelters, market wharves, bridge tolls, ferry taxes, tax-exempt estates, old and new magistrates, patrol troops and border garrisons—where anything burdens the people, the Masters of Writing and each province and commandery shall list them at once; whatever is reported shall be removed to ease the people's grief."
translations.idiomatic: Every distant post and inner rule, every garrison, relay station, lodge, smelter, market wharf, bridge toll, ferry tax, tax-exempt estate, old or new magistrate, patrol troop, and border garrison—where anything harms the people, the Masters of Writing and each province and commandery shall report it at once, and what is named shall be cut away to ease the people's pain."

sentences.zh: 夏四月，魏遣使來聘。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Wei sent envoys on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Wei sent envoys on a friendly visit.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己未，詔曰：「堯、舜以來，便開贖刑，中年依古，許罪身入貲，吏下因此，不無姦猾，所以一日復勑禁斷。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, day jiwei, an edict said: "From Yao and Shun, commutation of punishment was permitted; in middle antiquity, by ancient practice, the guilty could buy off punishment with goods. Subordinate officials therefore were not without fraud—hence an order one day forbade it again.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day in the tenth month of winter an edict said, "From Yao and Shun onward, bodily punishment could be redeemed; in middle antiquity the guilty paid goods to buy off penalty, and officials were not without fraud—so an order one day forbade it again.

sentences.zh: 川流難壅，人心惟危，旣乖內典慈悲之義，又傷外教好生之德。

translations.literal: Rivers are hard to dam, and the human heart is ever precarious—this goes against the Buddhist teaching of compassion and harms the foreign faith's virtue of cherishing life.
translations.idiomatic: Rivers are hard to block, and the human heart is ever fragile—this offends the inner teaching of compassion and wounds the outer faith's virtue of cherishing life.

sentences.zh: 《書》云：『與殺不辜，寧失不經。

translations.literal: The Book of Documents says: "Better to miss the irregular than to punish the innocent.
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Documents says, "Better to err than to punish the innocent,

sentences.zh: 』可復開罪身，皆聽入贖。」

translations.literal: " Commutation of bodily punishment may be opened again; all may redeem by payment."
translations.idiomatic: " Commutation may be opened again; all may redeem by payment."

sentences.zh: 中大同元年春正月丁未，曲阿縣建陵隧口石騏驎動，有大蛇鬬隧中，其一被傷奔走。

translations.literal: In Zhongdatong year 1, spring, first month, day dingwei, at Jianling pass in Qu'e county a stone qilin moved; a great serpent fought in the pass, and one was wounded and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day in the first month of spring in Zhongdatong 1, at Jianling pass in Qu'e county a stone qilin stirred; a great serpent fought in the pass, one was wounded, and fled.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，交州刺史楊瞟剋交趾嘉寧城，李賁竄入獠洞，交州平。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Jiaozhou Inspector Yang Piao took Jiaozhi's Jianing city; Li Ben fled into a Liao cave; Jiaozhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Jiaozhou inspector Yang Piao took Jianing city in Jiaozhi; Li Ben fled into a Liao cave, and Jiaozhou was pacified.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳，大赦天下：凡主守割盜、放散官物，及以軍糧器甲，凡是赦所不原者，起十一年正月以前，皆悉從恩，十一年正月已後，悉原加責；

translations.literal: On day yisi in the third month, a general amnesty: for magistrates who embezzled, seized, or dispersed government goods, or military grain and armor—all normally excluded from amnesty—if before the first month of the eleventh year, full grace; after that month, pardon with added penalties;
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day in the third month a general amnesty was proclaimed: embezzlement, seizure, or dispersal of government goods or military grain and armor—matters normally excluded—before the first month of the eleventh year received full grace; after that month, pardon with added penalties;

sentences.zh: 其或爲事逃叛流移，因饑以後亡鄉失土，可聽復業，蠲課五年，停其徭役；

translations.literal: those who fled, rebelled, or drifted for reasons or hunger after losing land may return to their trades, with five years' tax remission and corvée suspended;
translations.idiomatic: those who fled, rebelled, or drifted in hunger after losing land might return to their trades, with five years' tax remission and corvée suspended;

sentences.zh: 其被拘之身，各還本郡，舊業若在，皆悉還之。

translations.literal: those held in custody shall each return to their home commandery; old estates if still there are fully restored.
translations.idiomatic: those held in custody were sent home to their commanderies; old estates, where they remained, were fully restored.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，法駕出同泰寺大會，停寺省，講《金字三慧經》。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the imperial procession went to Tongtai Temple for a great assembly, lodged at the temple precinct, and lectured on the Gold-letter Three Wisdoms Sutra.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the imperial procession went to Tongtai Temple for a great assembly, lodged in the temple precinct, and lectured on the Gold-letter Three Wisdoms Sutra.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙戌，於同泰寺解講，設法會。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, day bingxu, at Tongtai Temple the lecture closed and a dharma assembly was held.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day in the fourth month of summer the lecture at Tongtai Temple closed and a dharma assembly was held.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed.

sentences.zh: 孝悌力田爲父後者賜爵一級，賚宿衛文武各有差。

translations.literal: Filial sons, obedient brothers, strong farmers, and eldest sons received one rank of nobility; palace guards civil and military received graded gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Filial sons, obedient brothers, strong farmers, and eldest sons received one rank of nobility; court guards civil and military received graded gifts.

sentences.zh: 是夜，同泰寺災。

translations.literal: That night, Tongtai Temple burned.
translations.idiomatic: That night Tongtai Temple burned.

sentences.zh: 六月辛巳，竟天有聲，如風雨相擊薄。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, day xinsi, a sound filled the heavens like wind and rain colliding.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day in the sixth month a sound filled the sky like wind and rain striking together.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉，以武昌王𧫷爲東揚州刺史。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, day xinyou, Prince of Wuchang Xu was made Eastern Yangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day in the seventh month of autumn Prince of Wuchang Xu was made Eastern Yangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔曰：「禽獸知母而不知父，無賴子弟過於禽獸，至於父母並皆不知。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, an edict said: "Beasts know their mothers but not their fathers; worthless sons surpass beasts in this—they do not know either parent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day an edict said, "Beasts know their mothers but not their fathers; worthless sons are worse—they know neither parent.

sentences.zh: 多觸王憲，致及老人。

translations.literal: Many violate royal law, and old people suffer for it.
translations.idiomatic: Many break royal law, and the aged suffer for it.

sentences.zh: 耆年禁執，大可傷愍。

translations.literal: Imprisoning the aged is deeply pitiable.
translations.idiomatic: To imprison the aged is deeply pitiable.

sentences.zh: 自今有犯罪者，父母祖父母勿坐。

translations.literal: From now, when one commits crime, parents and grandparents shall not be punished.
translations.idiomatic: From now on, when one commits a crime, parents and grandparents shall not be punished.

sentences.zh: 唯大逆不預今恩。

translations.literal: Only great treason is excluded from this grace."
translations.idiomatic: Only great treason is excluded from this grace."

sentences.zh: 」丙寅，詔曰：「朝四而暮三，衆狙皆喜，名實未虧，而喜怒爲用。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, an edict said: "Morning four and evening three—all the monkeys were pleased; name and substance did not change, yet joy and anger were the tools.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day an edict said, "Morning four and evening three—all the monkeys were pleased; name and substance did not change, yet joy and anger were the tools.

sentences.zh: 頃聞外間多用九陌錢，陌減則物貴，陌足則物賤，非物有貴賤，是心有顛倒。

translations.literal: Recently I hear much use of short-hundred coins outside—when the count is short, goods seem dear; when full, goods seem cheap. Goods do not truly rise or fall; the mind is inverted.
translations.idiomatic: Lately I hear much use of short-hundred coins outside—when the count falls short, goods seem dear; when full, goods seem cheap. Goods do not truly rise or fall; the mind is turned upside down.

sentences.zh: 至於遠方，日更滋甚。

translations.literal: In distant places it grows worse daily.
translations.idiomatic: In distant places it grows worse by the day.

sentences.zh: 豈直國有異政，乃至家有殊俗，徒亂王制，無益民財。

translations.literal: This is not merely different policy in the state but different custom in households—only disordering royal rule and harming the people's wealth.
translations.idiomatic: This is not merely different policy in the state but different custom in every household—only disordering royal rule and wasting the people's wealth.

sentences.zh: 自今可通用足陌錢。

translations.literal: From now full-hundred coins shall be used throughout.
translations.idiomatic: From now on full-hundred coins shall be used throughout.

sentences.zh: 令書行後，百日爲期，若猶有犯，男子謫運，女子質作，並同三年。」

translations.literal: One hundred days after this order—if there are still violators, men shall serve corvée transport, women pledged labor, both three years."
translations.idiomatic: One hundred days after this order, if there are still violators, men shall serve transport corvée and women pledged labor, both for three years."

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑，東揚州刺史武昌王𧫷薨。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day dingchou, Prince of Wuchang Xu, Eastern Yangzhou Inspector, died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day in the eighth month Prince of Wuchang Xu, Eastern Yangzhou inspector, died.

sentences.zh: 以安東將軍、南徐州刺史臨川王正義卽本號東揚州刺史，丹陽尹卲陵王綸爲鎮東將軍、南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Eastern Army General and South Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Linchuan Zhengyi was made Eastern Yangzhou Inspector under his existing title; Danyang Intendant Prince of Shaoling Lun was made General Who Pacifies the East and South Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Army General and South Xuzhou inspector Prince of Linchuan Zhengyi became Eastern Yangzhou inspector under his existing title; Danyang intendant Prince of Shaoling Lun became General Who Pacifies the East and South Xuzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 甲午，渴槃陁國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Kapisa sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Kapisa sent envoys with local tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉，汝陰王劉哲薨。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, day guiyou, Prince of Ruyin Liu Zhe died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day in the tenth month of winter Prince of Ruyin Liu Zhe died.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以前東揚州刺史岳陽王詧爲雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On day yihai, former Eastern Yangzhou Inspector Prince of Yueyang Cha was made Yongzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day former Eastern Yangzhou inspector Prince of Yueyang Cha was made Yongzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 太清元年正月壬寅，驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、荊州刺史廬陵王續薨；

translations.literal: In Taqing year 1, first month, day renyin, Rapid Cavalry Grand General with open office and third-rank ceremonial parity, Jingzhou Inspector Prince of Luling Xu died;
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day in the first month of Taqing 1, Rapid Cavalry Grand General Prince of Luling Xu, with open office and third-rank ceremonial parity and inspector of Jingzhou, died;

sentences.zh: 以鎮南將軍、江州刺史湘東王繹爲鎮西將軍、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the South and Jiangzhou Inspector Prince of Xiangdong Yi was made General Who Pacifies the West and Jingzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Pacifies the South and Jiangzhou inspector Prince of Xiangdong Yi became General Who Pacifies the West and Jingzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，輿駕親祠南郊，詔曰：「天行彌綸，覆燾之功博；

translations.literal: On day xinyou, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburb; an edict said: "Heaven's course spreads wide; its sheltering virtue is vast;
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the emperor sacrificed at the Southern Suburb in person; an edict said, "Heaven's course spreads wide; its sheltering virtue is vast;

sentences.zh: 乾道變化，資始之德成。

translations.literal: the Way of Heaven transforms and the virtue that nurtures beginnings is complete.
translations.idiomatic: the Way of Heaven transforms and the virtue that nurtures beginnings is complete.

sentences.zh: 朕沐浴齋宮，虔恭上帝，祗事槱燎，高熛太一，大禮克遂，感慶兼懷，思與億兆，同其福惠。

translations.literal: I have bathed in the fasting palace, reverently served August Heaven, performed the kindling sacrifice, raised the flame to the Great One—the great rite is done. Joy mingles with gratitude; I wish to share this blessing with the hundred millions.
translations.idiomatic: I have bathed in the fasting palace, reverently served August Heaven, performed the kindling sacrifice, and raised the flame to the Great One—the great rite is done. Joy mingles with gratitude, and I wish to share this blessing with the hundred millions.

sentences.zh: 可大赦天下，尤窮者無出卽年租調；

translations.literal: A general amnesty for the empire; the extremely poor need not pay this year's land tax and dues;
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty for the empire; the extremely poor need not pay this year's land tax and dues;

sentences.zh: 清議禁錮，並皆宥釋；

translations.literal: those barred by pure-critique censure are all released;
translations.idiomatic: those barred by pure-critique censure are all released;

sentences.zh: 所討逋叛，巧籍隱年，闇丁匿口，開恩百日，各令自首，不問往罪；

translations.literal: wanted fugitives, those who falsify registers or hide age and men—one hundred days of grace, each may surrender without question of past crimes;
translations.idiomatic: wanted fugitives, those who falsify registers or hide age and men—one hundred days of grace, each may surrender without question of past crimes;

sentences.zh: 流移他鄉，聽復宅業，蠲課五年；

translations.literal: those who drifted elsewhere may return to homes and trades, with five years' remission;
translations.idiomatic: those who drifted elsewhere may return to homes and trades, with five years' remission;

sentences.zh: 孝悌力田，賜爵一級；

translations.literal: filial sons, obedient brothers, and strong farmers receive one noble rank;
translations.idiomatic: filial sons, obedient brothers, and strong farmers receive one noble rank;

sentences.zh: 居局治事，賞勞二年。

translations.literal: those serving in office receive two years' labor reward.
translations.idiomatic: those serving in office receive two years' labor reward.

sentences.zh: 可班下遠近，博采英異，或德茂州閭，道行鄉邑，或獨行特立，不求聞達，咸使言上，以時招聘。

translations.literal: Let this be sent near and far; gather worthies—a man of virtue in his district, of the Way in his township, or of solitary integrity who seeks no fame—report all to the throne for timely summons."
translations.idiomatic: Let this be sent near and far; gather worthies—men of virtue in their districts, of the Way in their townships, or of solitary integrity who seek no fame—report all to the throne for timely summons."

sentences.zh: 」甲子，輿駕親祠明堂。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the emperor sacrificed at the Bright Hall in person.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: In the second month, day jimao, a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day in the second month a white rainbow pierced the sun.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，魏司徒侯景求以豫、廣、潁、洛、陽、西揚、東荊、北荊、襄、東豫、南兗、西兗、齊等十三州內屬。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Wei Minister over the Masses Hou Jing asked to submit thirteen provinces—Yu, Guang, Ying, Luo, Yang, Western Yang, Eastern Jing, Northern Jing, Xiang, Eastern Yu, Southern Yan, Western Yan, and Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Wei Minister over the Masses Hou Jing asked to submit thirteen provinces—Yu, Guang, Ying, Luo, Yang, Western Yang, Eastern Jing, Northern Jing, Xiang, Eastern Yu, Southern Yan, Western Yan, and Qi.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以景爲大將軍，封河南王，大行臺制承，如鄧禹故事。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Jing was made Grand General, enfeoffed Prince of Henan, and granted acting Grand Chancery authority after the precedent of Deng Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Hou Jing was made Grand General, enfeoffed Prince of Henan, and granted acting Grand Chancery authority after the precedent of Deng Yu.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，輿駕躬耕籍田。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the imperial carriage personally plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the emperor plowed the sacred field in person.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，高祖幸同泰寺，設無遮大會，捨身，公卿等以錢一億萬奉贖。

translations.literal: In the third month, day gengzi, Gaozu went to Tongtai Temple, held an unrestricted great assembly, and offered his body in renunciation; ministers and nobles contributed one hundred million in coin to ransom him.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day in the third month Gaozu went to Tongtai Temple, held an unrestricted great assembly, and offered his body in renunciation; ministers and nobles contributed one hundred million in coin to ransom him.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，遣司州刺史羊鴉仁、兗州刺史桓和、仁州刺史湛海珍等應接北豫州。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Si Province Inspector Yang Yaren, Yan Province Inspector Huan He, and Ren Province Inspector Zhan Haizhen were dispatched to reinforce Northern Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Si province inspector Yang Yaren, Yan province inspector Huan He, and Ren province inspector Zhan Haizhen were dispatched to reinforce Northern Yu.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁亥，輿駕還宮，大赦天下，改元，孝悌力田爲父後者賜爵一級，在朝羣臣宿衛文武並加頒賚。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, day dinghai, the imperial carriage returned to the palace; a general amnesty was proclaimed, the era name changed, filial sons, strong farmers, and eldest sons received one rank of nobility, and court officials and guards received gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day in the fourth month of summer the emperor returned to the palace; a general amnesty was proclaimed, the era changed, filial sons, strong farmers, and eldest sons received one rank of nobility, and court officials and guards received gifts.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉，輿駕幸德陽堂，宴羣臣，設絲竹樂。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, day dingyou, the imperial carriage visited Deyang Hall, feasted the officials, and set out string and bamboo music.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day in the fifth month the emperor visited Deyang Hall, feasted the officials, and set out string and bamboo music.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰，以前雍州刺史鄱陽王範爲征北將軍，總督漢北征討諸軍事。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, day wuchen, former Yongzhou Inspector Prince of Poyang Fan was made Northern Expedition General overseeing all northern campaigns on the Han.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day in the sixth month former Yongzhou inspector Prince of Poyang Fan was made Northern Expedition General overseeing all northern campaigns on the Han.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚申，羊鴉仁入懸瓠城。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, day gengshen, Yang Yaren entered Xuanchi city.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day in the seventh month of autumn Yang Yaren entered Xuanchi city.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔曰：「二豫分置，其來久矣。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, an edict said: "The two Yu provinces have been split long;
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day an edict said, "The two Yu provinces have long been split;

sentences.zh: 今汝、潁剋定，可依前代故事，以懸瓠爲豫州，壽春爲南豫，改合肥爲合州，北廣陵爲淮州，項城爲殷州，合州爲南合州。」

translations.literal: now Runan and Yingchuan are secured—by former precedent Xuanchi shall be Yu, Shouchun Southern Yu; Hefei renamed He Province, Northern Guangling Huai Province, Xiangcheng Yin Province, and He Province Southern He Province."
translations.idiomatic: now Runan and Yingchuan are secured—by former precedent Xuanchi shall be Yu, Shouchun Southern Yu; Hefei renamed He province, Northern Guangling Huai province, Xiangcheng Yin province, and He province Southern He province."

sentences.zh: 八月乙丑，王師北伐，以南豫州刺史蕭淵明爲大都督。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day yichou, the royal army marched north; South Yu Inspector Xiao Yuanming was made supreme commander.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day in the eighth month the royal army marched north, and South Yu inspector Xiao Yuanming was made supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「今汝南新復，嵩、潁載清，瞻言遣黎，有勞鑒寐，宜覃寬惠，與之更始。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Runan is newly recovered, Song and Ying cleared—seeing the people sent away, my thoughts are troubled in sleep and wakefulness. Broad mercy should be spread and a new beginning granted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "Runan is newly recovered, Song and Ying cleared—seeing the people sent away, my thoughts are troubled waking and sleeping. Broad mercy should be spread and a new beginning granted.

sentences.zh: 應是緣邊初附諸州部內百姓，先有負罪流亡，逃叛入北，一皆曠蕩，不問往諐。

translations.literal: All people in newly attached border provinces who owed guilt and fled north—all amnesty, past offenses not asked.
translations.idiomatic: All people in newly attached border provinces who owed guilt and fled north receive full amnesty, past offenses not asked.

sentences.zh: 並不得挾以私讎而相報復。

translations.literal: None may take private grudges to settle scores.
translations.idiomatic: None may take private grudges to settle scores.

sentences.zh: 若有犯者，嚴加裁問。

translations.literal: Violators shall be strictly investigated."
translations.idiomatic: Violators shall be strictly investigated."

sentences.zh: 」戊子，以大將軍侯景錄行臺尚書事。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Grand General Hou Jing was made acting director of the Grand Chancery Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Grand General Hou Jing was made acting director of the Grand Chancery Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，王游苑成。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day guimao, the Imperial Pleasure Garden was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day in the ninth month the Imperial Pleasure Garden was completed.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，輿駕幸苑。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the imperial carriage visited the garden.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the emperor visited the garden.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，魏遣大將軍慕容紹宗等至寒山。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, Wei sent Grand General Murong Shaozong and others to Hanshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter Wei sent Grand General Murong Shaozong and others to Hanshan.

sentences.zh: 丙午，大戰，淵明敗績，及北兗州刺史胡貴孫等並陷魏。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, a great battle was fought—Yuanming was defeated; Northern Yan Inspector Hu Guisun and others all fell to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day a great battle was fought—Yuanming was defeated, and Northern Yan inspector Hu Guisun and others all fell to Wei.

sentences.zh: 紹宗進圍潼州。

translations.literal: Shaozong advanced to besiege Tong Province.
translations.idiomatic: Shaozong advanced to besiege Tong province.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊辰，遣太子舍人元貞還北爲魏主。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, day wuchen, Crown Prince Attendant Yuan Zhen was sent north as envoy to the Wei ruler.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day in the twelfth month Crown Prince attendant Yuan Zhen was sent north as envoy to the Wei ruler.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以前征北將軍鄱陽王范爲安北將軍、南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, former Northern Expedition General Prince of Poyang Fan was made Pacification North General and South Yu Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day former Northern Expedition General Prince of Poyang Fan was made Pacification North General and South Yu inspector.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月戊戌，詔在位各舉所知。

translations.literal: In year 2, spring, first month, day wuxu, an edict ordered those in office to each recommend men they knew.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day in the first month of spring in year 2 an edict ordered those in office to each recommend men they knew.

sentences.zh: 己亥，魏陷渦陽。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Wei took Woyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Wei took Woyang.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以尚書僕射謝舉爲尚書令，守吏部尚書王克爲尚書僕射。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Xie Ju was made Director; Acting Minister of Personnel Wang Ke was made Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Vice Director Xie Ju became Director of the Masters of Writing, and acting Minister of Personnel Wang Ke became Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，豫州刺史羊鴉仁，殷州刺史羊思達，並棄城走，魏進據之。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Yu Inspector Yang Yaren and Yin Inspector Yang Sida both abandoned their cities and fled; Wei advanced and occupied them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Yu inspector Yang Yaren and Yin inspector Yang Sida both abandoned their cities and fled; Wei advanced and occupied them.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以大將軍侯景爲南豫州牧，安北將軍、南豫州刺史鄱陽王範爲合州刺史。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Grand General Hou Jing was made Governor of Southern Yu; Pacification North General Prince of Poyang Fan, South Yu Inspector, was made He Province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Grand General Hou Jing was made governor of Southern Yu, and Pacification North General Prince of Poyang Fan, South Yu inspector, was made He province inspector.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，撫東將軍高麗王高延卒，以其息爲寧東將軍、高麗王、樂浪公。

translations.literal: In the third month, day jiachen, Eastern Pacification General King Gao Yan of Goguryeo died; his son was made Pacification East General, King of Goguryeo, and Duke of Lelang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day in the third month Eastern Pacification General King Gao Yan of Goguryeo died; his son was made Pacification East General, king of Goguryeo, and Duke of Lelang.

sentences.zh: 己未，以鎮東將軍、南徐州刺史卲陵王綸爲平南將軍、湘州刺史、同三司之儀，中衛將軍、開府儀同三司蕭淵藻爲征東將軍、南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, General Who Pacifies the East and South Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Shaoling Lun was made Pacification South General, Xiangzhou Inspector with third-rank ceremonial parity; Central Guard General with open office and third-rank ceremonial parity Xiao Yuanzao was made Eastern Expedition General and South Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day General Who Pacifies the East and South Xuzhou inspector Prince of Shaoling Lun became Pacification South General and Xiangzhou inspector with third-rank ceremonial parity; Central Guard General Xiao Yuanzao, with open office and third-rank ceremonial parity, became Eastern Expedition General and South Xuzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 是日，屈獠洞斬李賁，傳首京師。

translations.literal: That day, Qu Liao cave executed Li Ben and sent his head to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: That day Qu Liao cave executed Li Ben and sent his head to the capital.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙子，詔在朝及州郡各舉清人任治民者，皆以禮送京師。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, day bingzi, an edict ordered court and provinces each to recommend upright men fit to govern the people, all to be escorted to the capital with ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day in the fourth month of summer an edict ordered court and provinces each to recommend upright men fit to govern the people, all to be escorted to the capital with ceremony.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以護軍將軍河東王譽爲湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Guard Army General Prince Yu of Hedong was made Xiangzhou inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Guard Army General Prince Yu of Hedong was made inspector of Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月辛丑，以新除中書令卲陵王綸爲安前將軍、開府儀同三司，前湘州刺史張纘爲領軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on xinchou, the newly dismissed Palace Secretariat Director Prince Lun of Shaoling was made Front-Pacification General with open office and third-rank ceremonial parity, and former Xiangzhou inspector Zhang Zuan was made General Who Commands the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day in the fifth month the newly dismissed Palace Secretariat Director Prince Lun of Shaoling was made Front-Pacification General with an open office and third-rank ceremonial parity, and former Xiangzhou inspector Zhang Zuan was made General Who Commands the Army.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，曲赦交、愛、德三州。

translations.literal: On xinhai, a partial amnesty was granted for Jiao, Ai, and De provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day a partial amnesty was granted for Jiao, Ai, and De provinces.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔曰：「爲國在於多士，寧下寄於得人。

translations.literal: On guichou, an edict said: "To govern a state depends on many officers; the peace of the realm depends on gaining worthy men.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day an edict said, "A state stands on many officers, and the realm's peace rests on finding the right men.

sentences.zh: 朕暗於行事，尤闕治道，孤立在上，如臨深谷。

translations.literal: I am dim in my conduct and especially lack the way of governance; alone above, I am as one standing at the edge of a deep ravine.
translations.idiomatic: I am blind in my actions and especially lack the way of governance; alone on high, I stand as at the lip of a deep gorge.

sentences.zh: 凡爾在朝，咸思匡救，獻替可否，用相啓沃。

translations.literal: All you in court should think to rescue and remedy; offer replacement and judgment on what may or may not be done, and thereby instruct and nourish me.
translations.idiomatic: All of you in court should think how to set things right; offer counsel on what to keep and what to change, and thereby guide and sustain me.

sentences.zh: 班下方嶽，傍求俊乂，窮其屠釣，盡其岩穴，以時奏聞。

translations.literal: Send this forth to the regional commanderies; seek worthy men on every side; exhaust the butchers and fishers, search every cliff and cave; report in due season."
translations.idiomatic: Send this to the regional commanderies; seek worthy men everywhere; search out hermits in caves and commoners at the plow; report what you find in season."

sentences.zh: 」是月，兩月夜見。

translations.literal: That month, the moon was seen twice.
translations.idiomatic: That month the moon appeared twice in one night.

sentences.zh: 秋八月乙未，以右衛將軍朱异爲中領軍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on yiwei, Right Guard General Zhu Yi was made Central Army Commander.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day in the eighth month of autumn Right Guard General Zhu Yi was made Central Army Commander.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，侯景舉兵反，擅攻馬頭、木柵、荊山等戍。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Hou Jing raised troops in rebellion and on his own authority attacked the garrisons of Matou, Muzha, Jingshan, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Hou Jing raised troops in rebellion and on his own authority attacked the garrisons at Matou, Muzha, Jingshan, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以安前將軍、開府儀同三司卲陵王綸都督衆軍討景。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Front-Pacification General with open office and third-rank ceremonial parity Prince Lun of Shaoling was made overall commander of the armies to suppress Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Front-Pacification General Prince Lun of Shaoling, with an open office and third-rank ceremonial parity, was made overall commander of the armies to suppress Hou Jing.

sentences.zh: 曲赦南豫州。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was granted for South Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: A partial amnesty was granted for South Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅，加左光祿大夫元羅鎮右將軍。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingyin, Left Grand Master for Splendid Happiness Yuan Luo was additionally given the title General Who Stabilizes the Right.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day in the ninth month Left Grand Master for Splendid Happiness Yuan Luo was additionally made General Who Stabilizes the Right.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，侯景襲譙州，執刺史蕭泰。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, Hou Jing raided Qiao province and captured its inspector Xiao Tai.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter Hou Jing raided Qiao province and captured its inspector Xiao Tai.

sentences.zh: 丁未，景進攻歷陽，太守莊鐵降之。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Jing advanced to attack Liyang; Administrator Zhuang Tie surrendered to him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Hou Jing advanced on Liyang, and Administrator Zhuang Tie surrendered to him.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以新除光祿大夫臨賀王正德爲平北將軍，都督京師諸軍，屯丹陽郡。

translations.literal: On wushen, the newly dismissed Grand Master for Splendid Happiness Prince Zhengde of Linhe was made General Who Pacifies the North, overall commander of the capital armies, and encamped in Danyang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the newly dismissed Grand Master for Splendid Happiness Prince Zhengde of Linhe was made General Who Pacifies the North, overall commander of the capital armies, and encamped in Danyang commandery.

sentences.zh: 己酉，景自橫江濟于採石。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Jing crossed from Hengjiang to Caishi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Hou Jing crossed from Hengjiang to Caishi.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，景師至京，臨賀王正德率衆附賊。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Jing's army reached the capital; Prince Zhengde of Linhe led his forces to join the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Hou Jing's army reached the capital, and Prince Zhengde of Linhe led his troops over to the rebels.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉，賊攻陷東府城，害南浦侯蕭推、中軍司馬楊暾。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinyou, the rebels captured Dongfu city and killed Marquis Tui of Nanpu and Central Army Major Yang Tun.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day in the eleventh month the rebels took Dongfu city and killed Marquis Tui of Nanpu and Central Army Major Yang Tun.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，卲陵王綸帥武州刺史蕭弄璋、前譙州刺史趙伯超等，入援京師，頓鐘山愛敬寺。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Prince Lun of Shaoling led Wu province inspector Xiao Nongzhang, former Qiao province inspector Zhao Bochao, and others to enter the capital in relief, encamping at Aijing Temple on Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Prince Lun of Shaoling led Wu province inspector Xiao Nongzhang, former Qiao province inspector Zhao Bochao, and others to relieve the capital and encamped at Aijing Temple on Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，綸進軍湖頭，與賊戰，敗績。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Lun advanced to Hutou and fought the rebels, but was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Prince Lun advanced to Hutou, fought the rebels, and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，安北將軍鄱陽王範遣世子嗣、雄信將軍裴之高等帥衆入援，次於張公洲。

translations.literal: On bingxu, General Who Pacifies the North Prince Fan of Poyang sent his heir Si, Bold-Faith General Pei Zhigao, and others to lead troops in relief, encamping at Zhanggong Islet.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day General Who Pacifies the North Prince Fan of Poyang sent his heir Si, Bold-Faith General Pei Zhigao, and others to lead relief troops and encamped at Zhanggong Islet.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，天西北中裂，有光如火。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wushen, the sky split open in the northwest with light like fire.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day in the twelfth month the sky split open in the northwest with a light like fire.

sentences.zh: 尚書令謝舉卒。

translations.literal: Director of the Masters of Writing Xie Ju died.
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Masters of Writing Xie Ju died.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，司州刺史柳仲禮、前衡州刺史韋粲、高州刺史李遷仕、前司州刺史羊鴉仁等並帥軍入援，推仲禮爲大都督。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Si province inspector Liu Zhongli, former Heng province inspector Wei Can, Gao province inspector Li Qianshi, former Si province inspector Yang Yaren, and others all led armies to enter in relief, and they raised Zhongli to supreme commander.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Si province inspector Liu Zhongli, former Heng province inspector Wei Can, Gao province inspector Li Qianshi, former Si province inspector Yang Yaren, and others all led armies to relieve the capital and raised Zhongli to supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丁巳朔，柳仲禮帥衆分據南岸。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on dingsi, the new moon; Liu Zhongli led his forces to hold positions along the south bank.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, the new moon of the first month of spring in year 3, Liu Zhongli led his forces to hold positions along the south bank.

sentences.zh: 是日，賊濟軍於青塘，襲破韋粲營，粲拒戰死。

translations.literal: That day, the rebels crossed the army at Qingtang, raided and broke Wei Can's camp; Can resisted in battle and died.
translations.idiomatic: That same day the rebels crossed at Qingtang, raided and broke Wei Can's camp, and Can died fighting.

sentences.zh: 庚申，卲陵王綸、東揚州刺史臨成公大連等帥兵集南岸。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Prince Lun of Shaoling, East Yangzhou inspector Duke Dalian of Lincheng, and others gathered troops on the south bank.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Prince Lun of Shaoling, East Yangzhou inspector Duke Dalian of Lincheng, and others gathered their armies on the south bank.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，中領軍朱异卒。

translations.literal: On yichou, Central Army Commander Zhu Yi died.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Central Army Commander Zhu Yi died.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以司農卿傅岐爲中領軍。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Minister of Finance Fu Qi was made Central Army Commander.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Minister of Finance Fu Qi was made Central Army Commander.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，高州刺史李遷仕、天門太守樊文皎進軍青溪東，爲賊所破，文皎死之。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Gao province inspector Li Qianshi and Tianmen administrator Fan Wenjiao advanced east of Qingxi and were broken by the rebels; Wenjiao died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Gao province inspector Li Qianshi and Tianmen administrator Fan Wenjiao advanced east of Qingxi, were broken by the rebels, and Wenjiao died in battle.

sentences.zh: 壬午，熒惑守心。

translations.literal: On renwu, Mars occupied the Heart constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Mars occupied the Heart constellation.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Venus was visible in daytime.

sentences.zh: 二月丁未南兗州刺史南康王會理、前青、冀二州刺史湘潭侯蕭退帥江州之衆，頓于蘭亭苑。

translations.literal: In the second month, on dingwei, South Yan province inspector Prince Huili of Nankang and former Qing and Ji provinces inspector Marquis Tui of Xiangtan led the armies of Jiang province, encamping at Lanting Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day in the second month South Yan province inspector Prince Huili of Nankang and former Qing and Ji provinces inspector Marquis Tui of Xiangtan led the armies of Jiang province and encamped at Lanting Garden.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，安北將軍、合州刺史鄱陽王範以本號開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On gengxu, General Who Pacifies the North Prince Fan of Poyang, He province inspector, was given his former title with open office and third-rank ceremonial parity.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day General Who Pacifies the North Prince Fan of Poyang, inspector of He province, was given his former title with an open office and third-rank ceremonial parity.

sentences.zh: 三月戊午，前司州刺史羊鴉仁等進軍東府北，與賊戰，大敗。

translations.literal: In the third month, on wuwu, former Si province inspector Yang Yaren and others advanced north of Dongfu and fought the rebels, suffering great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day in the third month former Si province inspector Yang Yaren and others advanced north of Dongfu, fought the rebels, and suffered great defeat.

sentences.zh: 己未，皇太子妃王氏薨。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the crown prince's consort Lady Wang died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the crown prince's consort Lady Wang died.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，賊攻陷宮城，縱兵大掠。

translations.literal: On dingmao, the rebels captured the palace city and let their troops plunder on a vast scale.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the rebels took the palace city and let their troops plunder without restraint.

sentences.zh: 己巳，賊矯詔遣石城公大款解外援軍。

translations.literal: On jisi, the rebels forged an edict sending Duke Dakuan of Shicheng to disband the relief armies from outside.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the rebels forged an edict sending Duke Dakuan of Shicheng to disband the outside relief armies.

sentences.zh: 庚午，侯景自爲都督中外諸軍事、大丞相、錄尚書。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Hou Jing made himself overall commander of all armies within and without, Grand Chancellor, and Recorder of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Hou Jing made himself overall commander of all armies within and without, Grand Chancellor, and Recorder of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 辛未，援軍各退散。

translations.literal: On xinwei, the relief armies each withdrew and dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the relief armies each withdrew and dispersed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，熒惑守心。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Mars again occupied the Heart constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Mars again occupied the Heart constellation.

sentences.zh: 壬午，新除中領軍傅岐卒。

translations.literal: On renwu, the newly appointed Central Army Commander Fu Qi died.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the newly appointed Central Army Commander Fu Qi died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己丑，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jichou, the capital region was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day in the fourth month of summer the capital region was shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 丙申，地又震。

translations.literal: On bingshen, the earth shook again.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the earth shook again.

sentences.zh: 己酉，高祖以所求不供，憂憤寢疾。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Gaozu, because his demands could not be met, sank into illness through grief and rage.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Gaozu, unable to obtain what he sought, fell ill with grief and rage.

sentences.zh: 是月，青、冀二州刺史明少遐、東徐州刺史湛海珍、北青州刺史王奉伯各舉州附于魏。

translations.literal: That month, Qing and Ji provinces inspector Ming Shaoxia, East Xuzhou inspector Zhan Haizhen, and North Qing province inspector Wang Fengbo each raised their provinces in submission to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: That month Qing and Ji provinces inspector Ming Shaoxia, East Xuzhou inspector Zhan Haizhen, and North Qing province inspector Wang Fengbo each surrendered their provinces to Wei.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰，高祖崩于淨居殿，時年八十六。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on bingchen, Gaozu died in the Hall of Pure Abiding; he was eighty-six years old.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day in the fifth month Gaozu died in the Hall of Pure Abiding at the age of eighty-six.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，遷大行皇帝梓宮于太極前殿。

translations.literal: On xinsi, the late emperor's coffin was moved to the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the late emperor's coffin was moved to the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，追尊爲武皇帝，廟曰高祖。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, he was posthumously honored as Emperor Wu; his temple name was Gaozu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter he was posthumously honored as Emperor Wu with the temple name Gaozu.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，葬于脩陵。

translations.literal: On yimao, he was buried at Xiuling.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day he was buried at Xiuling.

sentences.zh: 高祖生知淳孝。

translations.literal: Gaozu was innately pure in filial devotion.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu was born knowing pure filial devotion.

sentences.zh: 年六歲，獻皇太后崩，水漿不入口三日，哭泣哀苦，有過成人，內外親黨，咸加敬異。

translations.literal: At age six, when Empress Dowager Xian died, he took no water or food for three days; his weeping was so bitter that it surpassed an adult's, and kin near and far all regarded him with added reverence and wonder.
translations.idiomatic: At six, when Empress Dowager Xian died, he took no water or food for three days; his weeping was so bitter it surpassed an adult's, and kin near and far all looked on him with added reverence and wonder.

sentences.zh: 及丁文皇帝憂，時爲齊隨王諮議，隨府在荊鎮，仿佛奉聞，便投劾星馳，不復寢食，倍道就路，憤風驚浪，不暫停止。

translations.literal: When he entered mourning for Emperor Wen, he was then advisory aide to the Prince of Sui of Qi; the Sui princely establishment was stationed in Jing province. As soon as word of the death reached him, he submitted his resignation and raced off like a shooting star, neither sleeping nor eating, pressing the road at double pace through wind and storm without pause.
translations.idiomatic: When he entered mourning for Emperor Wen, he was advisory aide to Qi's Prince of Sui, whose establishment was stationed in Jing province. As soon as word reached him he resigned his post and raced off like a shooting star, neither sleeping nor eating, pressing the road at double pace through wind and storm without pause.

sentences.zh: 高祖形容本壯，及還至京都，銷毀骨立，親表士友，不復識焉。

translations.literal: Gaozu's frame had been robust, but when he returned to the capital he had wasted away to skin and bone; relatives, friends, and scholars could no longer recognize him.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu had been robust of frame, but when he returned to the capital he was wasted to skin and bone; relatives, friends, and scholars could no longer recognize him.

sentences.zh: 望宅奉諱，氣絕久之，每哭輒歐血數升。

translations.literal: When he reached home and received the taboo name, he lost breath for a long time; each time he wept he vomited several sheng of blood.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached home and received the taboo name he lost breath for a long while; each time he wept he vomited several sheng of blood.

sentences.zh: 服內不復嘗米，惟資大麥，日止二溢。

translations.literal: Throughout the mourning period he never again tasted rice; he lived only on barley, no more than two yi per day.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout mourning he never tasted rice again and lived only on barley, no more than two yi a day.

sentences.zh: 拜掃山陵，涕淚所灑，松草變色。

translations.literal: When he bowed at the imperial tombs, where his tears fell the pine grass changed color.
translations.idiomatic: When he bowed at the imperial tombs, wherever his tears fell the pine grass changed color.

sentences.zh: 及居帝位，卽於鐘山造大愛敬寺，青溪邊造智度寺，又於臺內立至敬等殿。

translations.literal: Once he took the throne, he built Great Aijing Temple on Zhongshan, built Zhidu Temple beside Qingxi, and within the palace raised halls such as Supreme Reverence.
translations.idiomatic: Once he took the throne he built Great Aijing Temple on Zhongshan, Zhidu Temple beside Qingxi, and within the palace halls such as Supreme Reverence.

sentences.zh: 又立七廟堂，月中再過，設淨饌。

translations.literal: He also established the Hall of the Seven Ancestral Temples; twice each month he visited and set out pure offerings.
translations.idiomatic: He also established the Hall of the Seven Ancestral Temples and twice each month visited it with pure offerings.

sentences.zh: 每至展拜，恒涕泗滂沲，哀動左右。

translations.literal: Whenever he performed the scheduled bowing, tears poured down without cease, and his grief moved all who attended him.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he performed the scheduled bowing tears poured down without cease, and his grief moved all who attended him.

sentences.zh: 加以文思欽明，能事畢究，少而篤學，洞達儒玄。

translations.literal: Moreover his literary thought was keen and bright, and he brought every task to completion; from youth he was deeply devoted to learning and penetrated both Confucian and Daoist learning.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover his literary mind was keen and bright, and he brought every task to completion; from youth he was deeply devoted to learning and mastered both Confucian and Daoist learning.

sentences.zh: 雖萬機多務，猶卷不輟手，燃燭側光，常至戊夜。

translations.literal: Though the myriad state affairs pressed upon him, he never laid aside his scrolls; by candlelight he read at his side, often until the fifth watch of night.
translations.idiomatic: Though myriad state affairs pressed upon him, he never laid aside his scrolls; by candlelight at his side he read, often until the fifth watch of night.

sentences.zh: 造《制旨孝經義》，《周易講疏》，及六十四卦、二《繋》、《文言》、《序卦》等義，《樂社義》，《毛詩答問》，《春秋答問》，《尚書大義》，《中庸講疏》，《孔子正言》，《老子講疏》，凡二百餘卷，並正先儒之迷，開古聖之旨。

translations.literal: He composed Imperial Intent Commentary on the Classic of Filial Piety, Lectures and Exegesis on the Changes, and commentaries on the sixty-four hexagrams, the two Appendices, the Statement on the Hexagrams, the Sequence of Hexagrams, and other texts; Commentary on the Community Sacrifice in the Book of Music; Questions and Answers on the Mao Odes; Questions and Answers on the Spring and Autumn Annals; Great Meaning of the Documents; Lectures on the Doctrine of the Mean; Correct Words of Confucius; Lectures on the Laozi — more than two hundred volumes in all, correcting the errors of earlier scholars and opening the intent of the ancient sages.
translations.idiomatic: He composed Imperial Intent Commentary on the Classic of Filial Piety, Lectures and Exegesis on the Changes, commentaries on the sixty-four hexagrams, the two Appendices, the Statement on the Hexagrams, the Sequence of Hexagrams, and other texts; Commentary on the Community Sacrifice in the Book of Music; Questions and Answers on the Mao Odes; Questions and Answers on the Spring and Autumn Annals; Great Meaning of the Documents; Lectures on the Doctrine of the Mean; Correct Words of Confucius; Lectures on the Laozi — more than two hundred volumes in all, correcting the errors of earlier scholars and opening the intent of the ancient sages.

sentences.zh: 王侯朝臣皆奉表質疑，高祖皆爲解釋。

translations.literal: Princes, marquises, and court ministers all submitted memorials with questions, and Gaozu answered every one.
translations.idiomatic: Princes, marquises, and court ministers all submitted memorials with questions, and Gaozu answered every one.

sentences.zh: 脩飾國學，增廣生員，立五館，置《五經》博士。

translations.literal: He restored and adorned the National University, expanded the student corps, established five academies, and appointed doctors for each of the Five Classics.
translations.idiomatic: He restored and adorned the National University, expanded the student corps, established five academies, and appointed doctors for each of the Five Classics.

sentences.zh: 天監初，則何佟之、賀㻛、嚴植之、明山賓等覆述制旨，並撰吉凶軍賓嘉五禮，凡一千餘卷，高祖稱制斷疑。

translations.literal: At the start of Tianjian, He Tongzhi, He Kun, Yan Zhizhi, Ming Shanbin, and others repeated and expounded the imperial intent, and together compiled the five rites — auspicious, inauspicious, military, guest, and celebratory — more than one thousand volumes in all; Gaozu personally settled doubtful points.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Tianjian He Tongzhi, He Kun, Yan Zhizhi, Ming Shanbin, and others repeated and expounded the imperial intent and together compiled the five rites — auspicious, inauspicious, military, guest, and celebratory — more than one thousand volumes in all; Gaozu personally settled doubtful points.

sentences.zh: 於是穆穆恂恂，家知禮節。

translations.literal: Thereafter the realm was reverent and orderly, and every household came to know ritual and propriety.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the realm was reverent and orderly, and every household came to know ritual and propriety.

sentences.zh: 大同中，於臺西立士林館，領軍朱异、太府卿賀琛、舍人孔子袂等遞相講述。

translations.literal: In the Datong era he established the Forest of Scholars Hall west of the palace; General Who Commands the Army Zhu Yi, Minister Steward He Chen, Palace Attendant Kong Zimei, and others lectured in turn.
translations.idiomatic: In the Datong era he established the Forest of Scholars Hall west of the palace, and General Who Commands the Army Zhu Yi, Minister Steward He Chen, Palace Attendant Kong Zimei, and others lectured in turn.

sentences.zh: 皇太子、宣城王亦於東宮宣猷堂及揚州廨開講，於是四方郡國，趨學向風，雲集於京師矣。

translations.literal: The crown prince and Prince Xuan of Xuancheng also opened lectures at the Hall of Proclaimed Instruction in the Eastern Palace and at the Yangzhou yamen; then from the commanderies and kingdoms in all four directions men hurried toward learning and the capital filled like clouds gathering.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince and Prince Xuan of Xuancheng also opened lectures at the Hall of Proclaimed Instruction in the Eastern Palace and at the Yangzhou yamen; then from commanderies and kingdoms in all four directions men hurried toward learning and gathered at the capital like clouds.

sentences.zh: 兼篤信正法，尤長釋典，制《涅盤》、《大品》、《淨名》、《三慧》諸經義記，復數百卷。

translations.literal: He was moreover deeply faithful to the true dharma and especially mastered Buddhist scriptures, compiling commentaries on the Nirvana, Mahaprajnaparamita, Vimalakirti, Three Wisdoms, and other sutras — again several hundred volumes.
translations.idiomatic: He was moreover deeply faithful to the true dharma and especially mastered Buddhist scriptures, compiling commentaries on the Nirvana, Mahaprajnaparamita, Vimalakirti, Three Wisdoms, and other sutras — again several hundred volumes.

sentences.zh: 聽覽餘閒，卽於重雲殿及同泰寺講說，名僧碩學，四部聽衆，常萬餘人。

translations.literal: In the intervals between hearing memorials he lectured at the Hall of Layered Clouds and at Tongtai Temple; eminent monks and great scholars, and audiences from the four quarters, often numbered more than ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the intervals between hearing memorials he lectured at the Hall of Layered Clouds and at Tongtai Temple; eminent monks and great scholars, and audiences from the four quarters, often numbered more than ten thousand.

sentences.zh: 又造《通史》，躬制贊序，凡六百卷。

translations.literal: He also composed the Comprehensive History, writing the prefaces and appraisals himself — six hundred volumes in all.
translations.idiomatic: He also composed the Comprehensive History, writing the prefaces and appraisals himself — six hundred volumes in all.

sentences.zh: 天情睿敏，下筆成章，千賦百詩，直疏便就，皆文質彬彬，超邁今古。

translations.literal: Heaven's endowment was keen and quick; he put brush to paper and prose sprang forth. A thousand fu and a hundred shi could be drafted straightaway, all balanced in substance and ornament, surpassing present and past.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's endowment was keen and quick; he put brush to paper and prose sprang forth. A thousand fu and a hundred shi could be drafted straightaway, all balanced in substance and ornament, surpassing present and past.

sentences.zh: 詔銘贊誄，箴頌箋奏，爰初在田，洎登寶曆，凡諸文集，又百二十卷。

translations.literal: Edicts, inscriptions, eulogies, dirges, admonitions, hymns, petitions, and memorials — from his first years in the countryside down to his ascension to the throne — all his collected works amounted to another one hundred and twenty volumes.
translations.idiomatic: Edicts, inscriptions, eulogies, dirges, admonitions, hymns, petitions, and memorials — from his first years in the countryside down to his ascension to the throne — all his collected works amounted to another one hundred and twenty volumes.

sentences.zh: 六藝備閑，棋登逸品，陰陽緯候，卜筮占決，並悉稱善。

translations.literal: He was practiced in all six arts; at go he reached the transcendent grade; in yin-yang, apocryphal texts, calendrical omens, divination, and oracle interpretation he all excelled.
translations.idiomatic: He was practiced in all six arts; at go he reached the transcendent grade; in yin-yang, apocryphal texts, calendrical omens, divination, and oracle interpretation he excelled in all.

sentences.zh: 又撰《金策》三十卷。

translations.literal: He also composed thirty volumes of Golden Stratagems.
translations.idiomatic: He also composed thirty volumes of Golden Stratagems.

sentences.zh: 草隸尺牘，騎射弓馬，莫不奇妙。

translations.literal: In cursive and clerical script, in letters and notes, in riding, archery, and horsemanship — there was nothing in which he was not marvelous.
translations.idiomatic: In cursive and clerical script, in letters and notes, in riding, archery, and horsemanship — there was nothing in which he was not marvelous.

sentences.zh: 勤於政務，孜孜無怠。

translations.literal: He was diligent in government affairs, tireless and unwearying.
translations.idiomatic: He was diligent in government affairs, tireless and unwearying.

sentences.zh: 每至冬月，四更竟，卽敕把燭看事，執筆觸寒，手爲皴裂。

translations.literal: Every winter, as soon as the fourth watch ended, he ordered candles brought to review business; his hand, touching the cold as he wrote, cracked and split.
translations.idiomatic: Every winter, as soon as the fourth watch ended, he ordered candles brought to review business; his hand, touching the cold as he wrote, cracked and split.

sentences.zh: 糾姦擿伏，洞盡物情，常哀矜涕泣，然後可奏。

translations.literal: In exposing wrongdoing and uncovering hidden guilt he penetrated human nature completely; he often wept in pity before he could approve a memorial for punishment.
translations.idiomatic: In exposing wrongdoing and uncovering hidden guilt he penetrated human nature completely; he often wept in pity before he could approve a memorial for punishment.

sentences.zh: 日止一食，膳無鮮腴，惟豆羹糲食而已。

translations.literal: He ate only one meal a day; his fare had no fresh delicacies — only bean broth and coarse grain.
translations.idiomatic: He ate only one meal a day; his fare had no fresh delicacies — only bean broth and coarse grain.

sentences.zh: 庶事繁擁，日儻移中，便嗽口以過。

translations.literal: When the myriad affairs pressed in and the day had already passed midday, he would rinse his mouth and take that as his meal.
translations.idiomatic: When myriad affairs pressed in and the day had already passed midday, he would rinse his mouth and take that as his meal.

sentences.zh: 身衣布衣，木綿皁帳，一冠三載，一被二年。

translations.literal: He wore plain cloth on his body, cotton and dark tents in his quarters; one cap for three years, one quilt for two.
translations.idiomatic: He wore plain cloth on his body, cotton and dark tents in his quarters; one cap for three years, one quilt for two.

sentences.zh: 常克儉於身，凡皆此類。

translations.literal: He was always frugal in his person — in all things it was thus.
translations.idiomatic: He was always frugal in his person — in all things it was thus.

sentences.zh: 五十外便斷房室。

translations.literal: After fifty he ceased entirely from the bedchamber.
translations.idiomatic: After fifty he ceased entirely from the bedchamber.

sentences.zh: 後宮職司，貴妃以下，六宮褘褕三翟之外，皆衣不曳地，傍無錦綺。

translations.literal: Among the palace offices, from honored consort downward — apart from the six inner palaces in their ceremonial robes of three pheasant patterns — all wore gowns that did not trail on the ground and had no brocade or damask at their sides.
translations.idiomatic: Among the palace offices, from honored consort downward — apart from the six inner palaces in their ceremonial robes of three pheasant patterns — all wore gowns that did not trail on the ground and had no brocade or damask at their sides.

sentences.zh: 不飲酒，不聽音聲，非宗廟祭祀、大會饗宴及諸法事，未嘗作樂。

translations.literal: He did not drink wine, did not listen to music; except for ancestral temple sacrifices, great assemblies and feasts, and Buddhist ceremonies, he never had music performed.
translations.idiomatic: He did not drink wine or listen to music; except for ancestral temple sacrifices, great assemblies and feasts, and Buddhist ceremonies, he never had music performed.

sentences.zh: 性方正，雖居小殿暗室，恒理衣冠，小坐押䙅，盛夏暑月，未嘗褰袒。

translations.literal: His nature was upright and square; even in a small hall or dark room he always arranged cap and robes; when seated briefly he kept his lap-belt neat; in the hottest months of summer he never bared his shoulders.
translations.idiomatic: His nature was upright and square; even in a small hall or dark room he always arranged cap and robes; when seated briefly he kept his lap-belt neat; in the hottest months of summer he never bared his shoulders.

sentences.zh: 不正容止，不與人相見，雖覿內豎小臣，亦如遇大賓也。

translations.literal: Without proper bearing he would not receive anyone; even when meeting a young palace attendant he did so as though greeting a great guest.
translations.idiomatic: Without proper bearing he would not receive anyone; even when meeting a young palace attendant he did so as though greeting a great guest.

sentences.zh: 歷觀古昔帝王人君，恭儉莊敬，藝能博學，罕或有焉。

translations.literal: Looking through the emperors and rulers of old, for reverent frugality, dignified bearing, artistic skill, and wide learning — rarely has there been his equal.
translations.idiomatic: Looking through the emperors and rulers of old, for reverent frugality, dignified bearing, artistic skill, and wide learning — rarely has there been his equal.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：齊季告終，君臨昏虐，天棄神怒，衆叛親離。

translations.literal: The historiographer says: When Qi's end drew near, the ruler sat in benighted cruelty; Heaven abandoned him and spirits were angered; the masses rebelled and kin turned away.
translations.idiomatic: The historiographer says: When Qi's end drew near, the ruler sat in benighted cruelty; Heaven abandoned him and spirits were angered; the masses rebelled and kin turned away.

sentences.zh: 高祖英武睿哲，義起樊、鄧，仗旗建號，濡足救焚，總蒼兕之師，翼龍豹之陣，雲驤雷駭，剪暴夷凶，萬邦樂推，三靈改卜。

translations.literal: Gaozu was heroic, martial, wise, and discerning; he raised righteousness from Fan and Deng, took up banners and established his title, waded through water to rescue those in fire; he gathered armies like azure rhinoceroses and winged dragon-leopards in their ranks; clouds soared and thunder shook as he cut down the violent and swept away the vicious; the myriad states gladly pushed him forward and the three spirits changed their oracle.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu was heroic, martial, wise, and discerning; he raised righteousness from Fan and Deng, took up banners and established his title, waded through water to rescue those in fire; he gathered armies like azure rhinoceroses and winged dragon-leopards in their ranks; clouds soared and thunder shook as he cut down the violent and swept away the vicious; the myriad states gladly pushed him forward and the three spirits changed their oracle.

sentences.zh: 於是御鳳曆，握龍圖，闢四門弘招賢之路，納十亂引諒直之<矢見>。

translations.literal: Thereupon he grasped the phoenix calendar and held the dragon chart; he opened the four gates and widened the road to recruit worthies; he took in the ten disruptors and drew in the frank and upright to mark his failings.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he grasped the phoenix calendar and held the dragon chart; he opened the four gates and widened the road to recruit worthies; he took in the ten disruptors and drew in the frank and upright to mark his failings.

sentences.zh: 興文學，脩郊祀，治五禮，定六律，四聰旣達，萬機斯理，治定功成，遠安邇肅。

translations.literal: He revived literature and learning, restored suburban sacrifice, regulated the five rites, and fixed the six pitches; the four listeners were reached and the myriad affairs thereby ordered; governance settled and achievement complete, the far were pacified and the near were awed.
translations.idiomatic: He revived literature and learning, restored suburban sacrifice, regulated the five rites, and fixed the six pitches; the four listeners were reached and the myriad affairs thereby ordered; governance settled and achievement complete, the far were pacified and the near were awed.

sentences.zh: 加以天祥地瑞，無絕歲時。

translations.literal: Moreover heavenly portents and earthly blessings did not cease from year to year.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover heavenly portents and earthly blessings did not cease from year to year.

sentences.zh: 征賦所及之鄉，文軌傍通之地，南超萬里，西拓五千。

translations.literal: In districts reached by levies and tribute, in lands connected by writing and wheelfracks, the south extended beyond ten thousand li and the west opened five thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In districts reached by levies and tribute, in lands connected by writing and wheelfracks, the south extended beyond ten thousand li and the west opened five thousand.

sentences.zh: 其中瑰財重寶，千夫百族，莫不充牣王府，蹶角闕庭。

translations.literal: Within them rare treasures and heavy gems, countless peoples and clans, all filled the imperial treasury; they came bowing with horns touching the ground before the palace gate.
translations.idiomatic: Within them rare treasures and heavy gems, countless peoples and clans, all filled the imperial treasury; they came bowing with horns touching the ground before the palace gate.

sentences.zh: 三四十年，斯爲盛矣。

translations.literal: For thirty or forty years, this was the height of splendor.
translations.idiomatic: For thirty or forty years this was the height of splendor.

sentences.zh: 自魏、晉以降，未或有焉。

translations.literal: Since Wei and Jin, there has never been its like.
translations.idiomatic: Since Wei and Jin there has never been its like.

sentences.zh: 及乎耄年，委事羣倖。

translations.literal: When he reached advanced age, he entrusted affairs to favored minions.
translations.idiomatic: In his old age he handed government over to favored minions.

sentences.zh: 然朱异之徒，作威作福，挾朋樹黨，政以賄成，服冕乘軒，由其掌握，是以朝經混亂，賞罰無章。

translations.literal: But Zhu Yi and his kind wielded power and enjoyed privilege, formed factions and built cliques, government was achieved through bribery, and who wore caps and rode chariots lay in their grasp—so court regulations fell into chaos and rewards and punishments lacked standard.
translations.idiomatic: But men like Zhu Yi made power and profit, formed factions, bought office with bribes, and controlled who held rank and rode in chariots—so court order collapsed and rewards and punishments had no rule.

sentences.zh: 「小人道長」，抑此之謂也。

translations.literal: "The way of petty men grows long"—this is what is meant.
translations.idiomatic: "The way of petty men grows long"—that is what this means.

sentences.zh: 賈誼有云「可爲慟哭者矣」。

translations.literal: Jia Yi said, "There is cause for bitter weeping."
translations.idiomatic: Jia Yi said, "One could weep in anguish over this."

sentences.zh: 遂使滔天羯寇，承間掩襲，鷲羽流王屋，金契辱乘輿，塗炭黎元，黍離宮室。

translations.literal: Thus heaven-filling Jie bandits seized the interval to raid by surprise; eagle pennants streamed to the royal hall, golden seals shamed the imperial carriage, the black-haired people were charred, and palaces turned to Grain Tall lament.
translations.idiomatic: Thus Jie bandits filled the heavens, seized their chance, and struck by surprise; eagle banners reached the royal hall, treaty seals humiliated the imperial carriage, the people were scorched, and palace halls became a scene of Grain Tall grief.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 天道何其酷焉。

translations.literal: How cruel is Heaven's way!
translations.idiomatic: How cruel Heaven's way is!

sentences.zh: 雖歷數斯窮，蓋亦人事然也。

translations.literal: Though the allotted span of the dynasty had reached its end, this was surely also a matter of human affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Though the dynastic tally had run its course, this was surely also the work of men.

translations.literal: Editorial footnote marker in the source text.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial footnote marker in the source text.

sentences.zh: 全文以中華書局、一九七三年五月版《梁書》爲本校。

translations.literal: The full text was collated against the Zhonghua Shuju edition of the Book of Liang (May 1973).
translations.idiomatic: The full text was collated against the Zhonghua Shuju edition of the Book of Liang (May 1973).
